entries: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)
Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user
Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)
Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt
Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)
Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code
Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled
Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill
Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers
Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector
Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch
Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway
Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse
Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence
Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts

Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back
Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求可直接開工作樹
title.en: Open a worktree straight from a GitLab merge request

body.zh-TW: 同事丟來 GitLab 的合併請求網址時，現在可把網址交給 `--worktree`，也能在 `claude agents` 檢視裡直接辨認它。工作樹（worktree，Git 為同一專案開出的平行副本）讓你另開一份地方查看修改，不必離開手邊工作。⟦這像收到一張待辦房間的門牌；網址一貼，便能走進另一間房核對內容，而非先手抄房號。⟧ 合併請求會顯示成 `!N`，因此清單裡能看出它是 GitLab 的項目。
body.en: When a teammate sends a GitLab merge-request URL, you can now give that URL to `--worktree` and recognize it in the `claude agents` view. A worktree is a parallel copy of a Git project, so you can inspect changes somewhere separate from current work. ⟦It is like receiving a room number on a work order: paste the address and walk into that room, rather than copying its number first.⟧ Merge requests appear as `!N`, making their GitLab identity visible in the list.

items.original: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)

title.zh-TW: 閘道可把使用者身分交給後端記帳
title.en: Gateway can pass user identity to proxy accounting

body.zh-TW: 公司透過 apps gateway 連到 Anthropic 上游服務，又想知道費用算在誰身上時，可選擇開啟 `forward_user_identity`。這個設定會把已登入使用者的身分放進 headers（隨請求附上的資訊欄位）。再交給閘道後方代替你轉送請求的 proxy。⟦像包裹經過收發室時附上寄件人卡片，後方的記帳人便能把運費記到對的人名下。⟧ 此設定是選用項目；不開啟便不會轉送這份身分資訊。
body.en: If your company connects to Anthropic upstreams through an apps gateway and needs to assign spending to people, it can opt into `forward_user_identity`. This setting puts the signed-in user's identity into request headers for a proxy behind the gateway. ⟦It is like attaching a sender card to a parcel at the mailroom, so the accountant down the line can charge delivery to the right person.⟧ Leave it off and that identity is not forwarded.

items.original: Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user

title.zh-TW: Linux Bash 可替失控建置設記憶體上限
title.en: Linux Bash can cap memory for a runaway build

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 用 Bash 工具跑建置，若擔心失控的建置拖住工作階段，可選擇設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`。它會替 Bash 指令啟用 memory cgroup（替一組程式設下記憶體界線的 Linux 機制）。⟦像共用儲物間替一台攪拌機劃出固定容量；它的材料塞滿自己的格子後，不能再占用整間空間，其他人的東西仍放得下。⟧ 這是選用支援，目的是避免失控的建置讓整個工作階段停住。
body.en: When a build runs through the Bash tool on Linux, you can opt into `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT` if a runaway build might stall the session. It enables a memory cgroup, Linux's boundary for the memory available to a group of programs. ⟦It is like giving one mixer a fixed storage compartment: once its ingredients fill that compartment, they cannot take over the whole storeroom, and everyone else's things still fit.⟧ The optional limit keeps a runaway build from stalling the session.

items.original: Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session

title.zh-TW: WebFetch 網址快取保存時間可自行設定
title.en: Set WebFetch URL cache lifetime yourself

body.zh-TW: 同一個 WebFetch 工作階段裡，想調整網址快取保存多久，現在可設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS`。快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）會在工作階段內保存網址查詢結果；這個變數專門調整它的存活時間。⟦像替已查過的電話簿頁面貼上有效期限標籤，到期前可直接翻那頁，到期後才重新查號。⟧ 預設值仍是 15 分鐘，沒有因這項設定而改變。
body.en: Within one WebFetch session, you can now set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` to choose how long its URL cache lasts. A cache keeps a URL lookup result for direct reuse during the session; this variable controls that lifetime. ⟦It is like putting an expiry label on a phone-book page you already checked: use that page until it expires, then look up the number again.⟧ The default remains 15 minutes.

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)

title.zh-TW: 雲端關機等權限時，不再誤報遺失工作階段
title.en: Cloud shutdown during a permission wait no longer loses session

body.zh-TW: Claude 正等你回應權限提示，雲端環境卻在此時關閉，先前偶爾會把雲端工作階段標成遺失。這次修正針對的正是「等待權限」與「環境關閉」同時發生的情況，也不把環境關閉誤當成工作階段遺失的錯誤依據。⟦如同櫃檯正等你簽名，辦公室卻先熄燈；現在不會因此把你的案件判成不見了。⟧ 之後遇到這種順序，工作階段不會再被錯誤標記為 lost。
body.en: If Claude was waiting at a permission prompt and the cloud environment shut down, a cloud session could occasionally be marked as lost. This fix covers that exact overlap: waiting for permission while the environment closes. ⟦It is like a desk clerk waiting for your signature when the office lights go out; the case is no longer declared missing because of that.⟧ In that situation, the session is no longer wrongly marked lost.

items.original: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt

title.zh-TW: MCP 長連線遇逾時不再反覆重開
title.en: MCP long connections stop reopening after timeouts

body.zh-TW: 使用會在固定時間結束長連線的 serverless 主機時，MCP v2 連線先前可能不停重開 `subscriptions/listen` 串流。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）透過這條串流接收訂閱資訊。⟦像對講機的通話被建築物規則切斷後，舊作法會不斷重撥同一通；現在不再陷入反覆接通又斷線。⟧ 因此，面對會終止長持連線的伺服器，連線不會無止盡重啟。
body.en: With a serverless host that ends long-held streams at a fixed timeout, an MCP v2 connection could keep reopening its `subscriptions/listen` stream. MCP is the protocol that connects AI to outside tools, and this stream receives subscription information. ⟦It is like an intercom call cut off by building rules, where the old behavior kept redialing the same call; it no longer cycles through reconnecting and dropping.⟧ Such servers no longer trigger endless stream reopening.

items.original: Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)

title.zh-TW: 桌面版與 VS Code 的權限提示會觸發通知掛鉤
title.en: Permission prompts trigger notification hooks in Desktop and VS Code

body.zh-TW: 你在 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 裡等權限提示，若設了 Notification hook，先前它可能沒有反應。Notification hook（通知掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）原本應在需要權限時告訴你。⟦像門鈴已接好線，訪客按了卻不響；現在有人要求進門時，鈴聲會跟著響起。⟧ 這項修正只針對兩個指定環境中的權限提示，讓掛鉤能正常觸發。
body.en: If you use a Notification hook while working in Claude Desktop or VS Code, it may previously have stayed silent for a permission prompt. A Notification hook is a small program triggered by an event and should notify you when permission is needed. ⟦It is like a wired doorbell that did not ring when a visitor pressed it; now the bell sounds when someone asks to enter.⟧ The fix covers permission prompts in those two environments.

items.original: Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code

title.zh-TW: Linux 閒置沙盒不再佔滿單一 CPU 核心
title.en: Idle Linux sandbox stops filling one CPU core

body.zh-TW: Linux 上開著沙盒卻沒有操作時，先前有些閒置工作階段仍會讓一個 CPU 核心維持 100% 使用率。沙盒（sandbox，隔開程式可碰範圍的受限環境）本應在你沒動作時安靜待著，而非持續消耗處理器。⟦像空無一人的房間裡，風扇卻一直全速轉；現在沒人使用時，不會白白耗住那一台風扇。⟧ 修正後，啟用沙盒的閒置工作階段不再出現這個單核心滿載問題。
body.en: On Linux, an idle session could keep one CPU core at 100% even when sandboxing was enabled. A sandbox is a restricted environment that limits what a program can touch, and it should sit quietly when unused. ⟦It is like a fan running at full speed in an empty room; when no one is using the room, it no longer consumes that fan for nothing.⟧ Idle sandboxed sessions no longer hit that single-core saturation.

items.original: Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled

title.zh-TW: 同名技能遮住內建指令時，別名仍可使用
title.en: Bundled aliases still work when same-named skills shadow them

body.zh-TW: 你在 `-p` 模式執行，或載入 plugins、MCP 後輸入 `/checkup`、`/review`，若使用者或專案技能恰好同名，先前可能看到「Unknown command」。技能（skill，教 Claude 完成特定工作的說明組）名稱相撞時，不該讓內建別名失效。⟦像社區裡新開一家同名店，舊店的招牌卻被整塊蓋住；現在兩個既有別名仍找得到入口。⟧ 這次修正涵蓋 `-p`，以及 plugins 或 MCP 已載入的情況。
body.en: In `-p` mode, or after loading plugins or MCP, entering `/checkup` or `/review` could produce “Unknown command” if a user or project skill had the same name. A skill is a set of instructions that teaches Claude a particular job, and a name collision should not hide bundled aliases. ⟦It is like a new shop with the same name covering an older shop's whole sign; now both bundled aliases still have a visible entrance.⟧ The fix covers `-p` and the loaded plugin or MCP cases.

items.original: Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill

title.zh-TW: 指令參數不會再被當成模板標記重算
title.en: Command arguments no longer get re-read as template markers

body.zh-TW: 技能或指令收到參數後，先前參數內容可能再被展開成 template markers（模板標記，會被程式替換的特殊符號）。這會把原本只是輸入值的文字，再當成另一輪要處理的指示，改變原有輸入的意思。⟦好比表單收件員已把你寫的姓名放進欄位，卻又把姓名當成填表規則重新解讀。⟧ 現在參數代入一次後便保留其值，不會被再次展開成模板標記。
body.en: After a skill or command received an argument, its value could be expanded again as template markers: special symbols the program replaces. That treated input text as another instruction to process. ⟦It is like a form clerk placing your written name in a field, then reading the name again as instructions for filling out the form.⟧ Now an argument keeps its value after substitution instead of becoming template markers again.

items.original: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers

title.zh-TW: Windows 特殊路徑不能繞過網路路徑檢查
title.en: Windows device paths cannot bypass network-path checks

body.zh-TW: Windows 路徑若用 NT 的 `\??\` device prefix 拼寫，先前可能繞過 UNC 路徑驗證，留下 NTLM 憑證外洩風險。UNC 路徑驗證（檢查網路共享位置寫法的安全檢查）原本就該攔住這類路徑。⟦像大樓正門的證件檢查做得完整，卻有一扇寫法不同的側門沒被納入；現在側門也進了同一道檢查。⟧ 這項修正關閉的是透過該特殊前綴造成的 NTLM credential-leak 漏洞。
body.en: On Windows, a path spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix could bypass UNC path validation and expose an NTLM credential-leak vector. UNC validation is the safety check for network-share path spelling and should catch such paths. ⟦It is like a building's main entrance checking badges while a side door written differently was left outside the same check; now that side door is checked too.⟧ The fix closes the leak route created through that special prefix.

items.original: Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器啟動時不再改寫工作樹
title.en: Self-hosted runner starts without rewriting worktree

body.zh-TW: 啟動 `claude self-hosted-runner` 時，現在會先建立工作階段分支，且不必改寫工作樹。工作階段（session，一次持續工作的連線與狀態）一開始少了會擋住 agent 啟動的兩次伺服器往返。⟦像劇團開演前先在後台把分場表放好，不必把整個舞台重新布置完才准演員上場。⟧ 因此，這個 runner 的工作階段啟動時間獲得改善，agent 不再被那兩次往返阻住。
body.en: When starting `claude self-hosted-runner`, the session branch is now created without rewriting the worktree. A session is the connection and state for one continuous stretch of work, and its start no longer waits for two server round trips that blocked the agent launch. ⟦It is like placing the scene list backstage before a play, rather than rebuilding the whole stage before actors may enter.⟧ The runner's session starts faster because those two round trips no longer block the agent.

items.original: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch

title.zh-TW: 閘道轉送上游錯誤原文，方便看懂問題
title.en: Gateway forwards upstream error message itself

body.zh-TW: apps gateway 接到 Vertex、Foundry 或 AWS 上 Claude Platform 回傳的 400 或 413 錯誤時，現在會帶出上游服務自己的錯誤訊息。上游（upstream，請求原本要送往的服務端）說明能讓你看到它實際拒絕的理由。⟦像客服把倉庫退貨單的原話交給你，而非只說「出問題了」，你才知道該改哪一項。⟧
body.en: When an apps gateway receives a 400 or 413 error from Vertex, Foundry, or Claude Platform on AWS, it now carries the upstream service's own message. An upstream is the service the request was meant to reach, so its message tells you why it rejected the request. ⟦It is like support handing you the warehouse's exact return slip instead of saying only “there is a problem,” so you know what to change.⟧

items.original: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway

title.zh-TW: apps gateway 的自動壓縮錯誤已修正
title.en: Apps gateway auto-compact bug is fixed

body.zh-TW: 使用 apps gateway 的 auto-compact 時，這項錯誤已修正。auto-compact（自動壓縮，將較早對話整理得更短以騰出內容空間）是 gateway 替工作階段整理內容的流程。⟦像整理員把塞滿的資料夾換成精簡摘要，原本卡住的整理步驟現在能完成。⟧ 因此，透過 apps gateway 進行自動壓縮時，不再受這項錯誤影響。
body.en: A bug in auto-compact on apps gateway is fixed. Auto-compact condenses earlier conversation to make room for more content in a session. ⟦It is like an organizer replacing an overstuffed folder with a shorter summary, so the filing step that was stuck can now finish.⟧ Auto-compact through apps gateway is no longer affected by this bug.

items.original: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證可找出技能說明檔格式錯誤
title.en: Plugin validation finds malformed skill description files

body.zh-TW: 準備檢查 plugin 時，`claude plugin validate` 現在會查看單獨存在的 `.claude/skills` 資料夾。它會回報其中 frontmatter（檔案開頭給工具讀取的欄位）無法解析的 SKILL.md。⟦像出版前先翻開資料夾裡每本說明書的扉頁，哪本的基本資料讀不出來，便直接標給你。⟧ 即使 `.claude/skills` 是裸資料夾而非完整結構，驗證也會納入檢查。
body.en: When checking a plugin, `claude plugin validate` now examines a bare `.claude/skills` directory. It reports SKILL.md files whose frontmatter, the fields at a file's beginning for tools to read, cannot be parsed. ⟦It is like opening the title page of every manual in a folder before publication and marking any whose basic details cannot be read.⟧ Validation includes `.claude/skills` even when it stands alone rather than inside a full structure.

items.original: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器可用數字選擇努力程度
title.en: Screen readers can choose effort with numbers

body.zh-TW: 使用螢幕閱讀器調整 `/effort` 時，選擇器現在會呈現成編號清單，並要求輸入對應數字。螢幕閱讀器（screen reader，把畫面內容讀出聲的輔助工具）需要能循序讀懂每個操作選項與目前選擇。⟦像語音點餐不必在看不見的按鈕間猜位置，只要聽完菜單後說出菜號。⟧ 此外，提示文字和對話框文字不再被裁切，讀到的內容能完整保留。
body.en: When using a screen reader to change `/effort`, the selector now appears as a numbered list and asks for a typed number. A screen reader is an assistive tool that reads screen content aloud and needs an ordered way to convey choices. ⟦It is like ordering by voice without guessing among unseen buttons: hear the menu, then say the dish number.⟧ Hint text and dialog text are no longer clipped either.

items.original: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

title.zh-TW: 列印模式會提示未認得的模型 ID
title.en: Print mode flags unrecognized model IDs

body.zh-TW: 用 print mode 送出 Claude Code 不認得的 model ID 時，現在 stderr（標準錯誤輸出，程式用來報告問題的文字通道）會寫出 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`。這條診斷訊息告訴你請求確實帶了未識別的模型 ID。⟦像寄件櫃檯在收據蓋上「地址查無」章，而非讓包裹悄悄進入未知路線。⟧ 若想不再看到它，可用 `modelOverrides` 將該模型 ID 對應到已知模型。
body.en: If print mode sends a model ID Claude Code does not recognize, stderr, the program's text channel for reporting problems, now writes `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`. The diagnostic line tells you the request went out with an unknown model ID. ⟦It is like a mailing counter stamping “address not found” on the receipt instead of quietly sending a parcel onto an unknown route.⟧ Map that ID with `modelOverrides` to silence the line.

items.original: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence

title.zh-TW: 非 GitHub 儲存庫不再收到錯誤的 App 設定提醒
title.en: Non-GitHub repositories stop getting wrong app setup tip

body.zh-TW: 你的儲存庫 origin remote 在 gitlab.com 或 bitbucket.org 時，GitHub app 設定提示不再冒出來。origin remote（儲存庫連向遠端來源的位置）既不是 GitHub，就不該叫你設定 GitHub app。⟦像火車站不會把前往另一座城市的旅客帶到錯誤月台；現在目的地不是 GitHub，便不發那張車票。⟧ 同時，enterprise marketplace 提示會涵蓋不是 GitHub 的內部 Git 主機。
body.en: If a repository's origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org, the GitHub app setup tip no longer appears. title.zh-TW: Windows Bash 權限調整收回過寬規則
title.en: Windows Bash permission change narrows back overly broad rules

body.zh-TW: Windows 的 auto mode 對一般 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 指令反覆停下要求手動核准，這個 2.1.232 回歸問題已修正。同時，2.1.232 對 Cygwin 風格符號連結與輸入重新導向 `< file` 的 Bash 權限改動被撤回。⟦像門禁先把普通的進出與兩種指定通道都攔下；現在普通路線恢復通行，而過寬的兩條規則先收回，等待較精準版本。⟧ 較窄的版本會在後續版本回來。
body.en: On Windows, auto mode repeatedly stopped for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands; that 2.1.232 regression is fixed. At the same time, 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks and input redirection `< file` have been reverted. ⟦It is like access control stopping ordinary passage and two named lanes; ordinary travel resumes, while the two overbroad rules are withdrawn until a narrower version returns.⟧ A narrower version will arrive in a later release.

title.zh-TW: 分身代理接手完整脈絡，也改在背景工作

body.zh-TW: 你正和 Claude 討論一個長問題，又想找另一個代理分頭處理，現在不用先把前情重講一遍。`subagent_type: "fork"` 的子代理（由目前對話分出的工作幫手）會帶著完整對話和 prompt cache，先前提示內容的暫存結果，出發。互動工作階段裡，非團隊代理的啟動預設也改為背景執行，不會把眼前對話卡在等待畫面。像把同一本已夾好書籤的筆記交給同事，他從你停下的段落開始讀，並到隔壁桌處理，不必佔著你的座位。

In interactive sessions, non-teammate agents also start in the background by default. It is like handing a colleague a notebook already marked at the right page, then letting them work at the next desk instead of taking over yours.

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳話，直接叫名字就能找到人

title.zh-TW: Gateway 設定先驗證，不再悄悄套錯規則

body.en: Gateway now accepts every released Desktop setting in the `desktop:` overlay and validates it against Desktop's schema at boot; unknown or invalid keys fail boot. Empty `managed.policies[].match.groups` or `admin.admin_groups`, and malformed `email_domain` values, also fail boot instead of silently matching nobody or granting admin access.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5 顧問回來了，離開互動模式也不會拿錯指示
title.en: Fable 5 returns to Advisor with a corrected consent message

title.zh-TW: 命令改寫檔案與輸入重導，都重新要過同意
title.en: Commands that can redirect file access now require permission approval

body.zh-TW: 權限確認不是只看命令表面長相。PowerShell 的會寫入變數參數原本可悄悄覆寫 `$PSDefaultParameterValues`，再把後續命令的檔案存取導向別處，這條繞過已封住。Windows 上 Git Bash 把 Cygwin-style symlink（Cygwin 格式的符號連結，指向另一位置的捷徑檔）當一般檔案看，卻會跟著它寫入；現在這類寫入需要權限同意。所有平台的 Bash 輸入重導 `< file` 也和一般參數拼法一樣納入權限檢查。像保全不只查門牌，也會看通往後門的暗道和代收指示；能把手伸到別處的路，都先要你點頭。

PowerShell parameters that write variables can no longer silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands. Git Bash writes through Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows require approval, and Bash input redirections (`< file`) are permission-checked on every platform.

title.zh-TW: 巢狀 Git 專案各自確認信任
title.en: Nested Git repositories now earn trust separately

body.zh-TW: 一個 Git 專案裡如果再放另一個 Git 專案，內層專案不會再因為外層資料夾已被信任，就自動繼承並通過。現在每個巢狀 repository（程式碼版本管理專案）都需要各自獲得獨立的信任確認。這項修正保留了你已信任外層資料夾的意思，同時不會把那份信任自動擴張到裡面包含的另一份專案。像你同意朋友進大樓大門，不等於也同意他打開大樓內的每一戶房門；每扇內門仍需要各自獨立確認。
body.en: A Git repository inside another Git repository no longer inherits trust from its parent directory. Each repository now needs its own trust confirmation. Trusting the outer project still means trusting that project; it does not automatically extend to a separate project inside it.

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器不回話時，連線不再久等
title.en: MCP connections stop waiting so long for a broken server reply

body.zh-TW: 外部工具連不上時，Claude 不會再傻等完整的連線逾時。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若沒有回覆，或回覆 protocol-version probe，確認雙方協定版本的詢問，時格式壞掉，舊行為會一路等到完整的 30-second connect timeout。現在這種失敗會及早結束。它像按門鈴後對方完全沒回應，或從門縫遞出看不懂的紙條；你不用站在門前一直等，能早點知道這扇門暫時進不去。
body.en: When an MCP server does not answer, or gives a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe, a connection no longer waits through the full 30-second connect timeout. MCP is the protocol that connects AI to external tools. It is like ringing a doorbell and getting either silence or an unreadable note; you find out sooner that this door cannot be used now.

items.original: Fixed MCP connections hanging for the full 30-second connect timeout when a server fails to answer or sends a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制續接回原對話，歷史也能復原
title.en: Remote Control reconnects to the right conversation and restores its history

body.zh-TW: 你從 Claude Desktop 或 IDE 用 Remote Control（遠端控制，把本機工作階段接到另一端使用）後暫停再回來，現在會重新接到原本的 claude.ai 工作階段，不會每次都被當成新工作階段。新接上的用戶端在閒置時也不會顯示連不到，bridge（連接兩端的橋接程式）工作階段的 worker，實際處理工作的程序，重啟後，對話歷史會恢復。若 claude.ai 或應用程式已刪掉原工作階段，恢復對話則會開始替代工作階段，不會錯說是登入問題。像遠端回辦公桌時，能找回原本抽屜與筆記；抽屜真被清空才換一張新桌，而不是誤說你的門禁卡失效。

Newly attached clients remain reachable while idle, and bridge-session history is restored after its worker restarts. If the original session was deleted from claude.ai or the app, resuming starts a replacement instead of reporting a login problem.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制斷線會重連，也會說清楚控制權去哪了
title.en: Remote Control reconnects after a blip and explains who has control

body.zh-TW: 網路一晃、或同一台機器上另一個 Claude Code 接手時，Remote Control 不再默默把你留在猜測裡。網路短暫中斷後，它會持續嘗試重連約 30 minutes，也不會因為跨 1 hour 出現幾次短暫中斷就放棄。若另一個 Claude Code 仍握有控制權，恢復對話不會悄悄搶走它；要移轉請在那裡執行 `/remote-control`。終端機也會明說工作階段被別台裝置接手、從其他應用程式結束，或已刪除，並停止建議會把變更撤銷的重連。像接力棒還在別人手上時，裁判會告訴你原因與交棒位置，而不是讓兩個人同時伸手搶。
body.en: After a network blip, Remote Control keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour. Resuming does not silently take control from another Claude Code on the same machine; run `/remote-control` there to move it. The terminal now says whether another device took over, another app ended, or deleted the session, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo that state.

items.original:
Remote Control now keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes after a network blip and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour
Remote Control: resuming a conversation no longer silently takes Remote Control away from another Claude Code on the same machine that still has it; run `/remote-control` there to move it
Remote Control: the terminal now says whether a session was taken over by another device, ended from another app, or deleted, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo it

title.zh-TW: 雲端登入與語音被拒，現在會直接告訴你原因
title.en: Cloud login and rejected voice connections now show the reason

body.zh-TW: 按下 Cloud gateway 的 `/login`，看到「Press Enter to continue」後卻沒反應，舊版可能直接離開或留下無回應的終端機；原因是受管理設定載入失敗。現在它會顯示原因。原生版本的 voice mode（語音模式）若被語音服務拒絕，以前可能卡在「listening…」，現在也會立即顯示拒絕。兩件事都把原本沉默的失敗變成可讀訊息：像櫃台不能替你辦理時，會說明缺哪張資料，而不是把你晾在寫著「請稍候」的牌子前。
body.en: When managed settings fail to load, Cloud gateway `/login` no longer exits silently or leaves an unresponsive terminal after “Press Enter to continue”; it shows the reason. On native builds, voice mode no longer stays on “listening…” when the voice service rejects its connection; that rejection appears immediately.

items.original:
Fixed Cloud gateway `/login` exiting silently or leaving an unresponsive terminal after "Press Enter to continue" when managed settings failed to load; the reason is now shown
Fixed voice mode on native builds getting stuck on "listening…" when the voice service rejected the connection; the rejection is now shown immediately

title.zh-TW: 雲端連線可換新憑證，也能從逾時接回工作
title.en: Cloud connections reload rotated certificates and recover from idle timeouts

body.zh-TW: mTLS client certificate（mTLS 用戶端憑證，雙向驗證連線身分的證明）輪替後，舊版要重啟 Claude Code 才會讀到新憑證與金鑰；現在遇到連線錯誤會自動重新載入。Bedrock、Vertex 與 gateway 部署遇到 stream idle timeout（串流閒置逾時）時，舊版會讓請求失敗，現在會嘗試恢復。AWS 或 Vertex 的 region（服務區域）值格式壞掉時，也不再拿它拼出請求網址，會改回 default region。像長途電話遇到換發的新識別證或短暫靜音，接線員會重讀證件、改撥預設區域並嘗試接回通話。
body.en: After an mTLS client certificate rotation, Claude Code now reloads the certificate and key on connection errors instead of requiring a restart. Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments recover from stream idle timeout errors rather than failing the request. Malformed AWS or Vertex region values no longer build request URLs and fall back to the default region.

items.original:
Fixed mTLS client certificate rotation requiring a restart; Claude Code now reloads the rotated cert and key automatically on connection errors
Fixed malformed AWS or Vertex region values being used to build request URLs; they now fall back to the default region
Fixed stream idle timeout errors failing the request instead of recovering on Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments

title.zh-TW: 被截斷的文字不再撐寬畫面或冒出亂碼
title.en: Truncated text no longer widens overlays or leaves a garbled character

body.zh-TW: 畫面上的 overlay（覆蓋在主畫面上的小面板）依內容決定寬度時，文字被截斷會不再多畫出一欄；從開頭截斷的文字也不會縮成只有省略號。很長的 shell command（殼層命令）或 agent description，代理描述，預覽在 emoji，表情符號，中間被切斷時，先前還可能留下一個亂碼字元，現在已修好。這些都是同一個「文字只顯示一部分」的邊角：像招牌裁短字句時，不會多做一格空白，也不會把圖案切成一塊看不懂的碎片。
body.en: A content-sized overlay no longer renders one column too wide when its text is truncated, and text truncated at the start no longer collapses to an ellipsis. A long shell-command or agent-description preview cut mid-emoji also no longer leaves a stray garbled character. These are fixes for displaying only part of a string without distorting what remains.

items.original:
Fixed content-sized overlays containing truncated text rendering one column too wide, and start-truncated text collapsing to an ellipsis
Fixed a stray garbled character where a long shell-command or agent-description preview was cut off mid-emoji

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集同時寫入時，不會被意外取消登記
title.en: A plugin marketplace no longer disappears during simultaneous startup writes

body.zh-TW: 剛啟動 Claude Code 時，若多個工作同時寫入 `known_marketplaces.json`，原本有一個競爭時機，可能悄悄把已登記的外掛市集取消登記。現在這個 startup race（啟動時的競爭狀況）已修好，市集不會因為同時寫檔而消失。你不必看到外掛來源忽然不見，卻找不到錯誤訊息。這如同幾位店員同時更新同一本供應商名冊時，現在不會有人把另一人剛寫好的店名抹掉。
body.en: A startup race caused by concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json` could silently unregister a plugin marketplace. That race is fixed, so a registered marketplace no longer disappears when startup work writes the file at the same time.

items.original: Fixed a startup race that could silently unregister a plugin marketplace due to concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json`

title.zh-TW: 可繼續的工作在跑，更新介面也能重啟
title.en: Update and TUI can restart while surviving work is running

body.zh-TW: 你要執行 `/update` 或 `/tui`，同時又有重啟後仍會存活的工作正在跑，先前這兩個指令可能拒絕重啟。現在它們不會因為那類工作還在運作就擋住。這不是把工作中止，而是承認它能跨過重新啟動繼續存在，讓更新或文字介面能照常重新開始。像一棟大樓有獨立供電的設備仍在運轉時，管理員可以重開大廳的顯示面板，不必把整棟樓的工作都先關掉。
body.en: `/update` and `/tui` no longer refuse to restart just because work that survives the relaunch is running. That work is not being stopped; the update or text interface can restart while it continues to survive the relaunch.

items.original: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` refusing to restart while work that survives the relaunch was running

title.zh-TW: 額度用完時，只推薦目前真的能用的指令
title.en: Usage-limit guidance now recommends only available slash commands

body.zh-TW: 在 SDK 或遠端工作階段遇到 usage limit（使用額度上限）時，Claude 的說明以前可能建議你一個該環境根本沒有的 slash command，以 `/` 開頭的指令，。現在建議會避開不可用指令。這項修正不改變你的額度，也不憑空增加指令；它只讓卡住時的說明符合你手邊能操作的介面。像車站告示不再指你去一個已封閉的月台，而是只指向目前能走的出口。
body.en: In SDK and remote sessions, usage-limit guidance no longer suggests slash commands that are unavailable in that environment. It does not change the limit or add commands; it makes the guidance point only to actions that the current session can actually use.

items.original: Fixed usage-limit guidance suggesting unavailable slash commands in SDK and remote sessions

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制不再帶走雲端工作階段的內容與憑證
title.en: Remote Control no longer inherits a cloud session’s transcript or credentials

body.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 bridge（連接兩端的橋接程式）若主持 Remote Control，遠端控制，把本機工作階段接到另一端使用，，以前遠端控制工作階段可能繼承那個雲端工作階段的 transcript，對話逐字紀錄，或 credentials，登入身分證明，。現在這份繼承關係已移除。遠端控制還是能由橋接程式主持，但不會把主持它的雲端工作階段內容或登入證明一起帶進去。這像在共享會議室接通投影設備，不會順便把上一場會議的筆記和門禁卡交給下一位使用者。
body.en: A Remote Control session hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session no longer inherits that cloud session’s transcript or credentials. The bridge can still host Remote Control, but the hosted session does not receive the cloud session’s conversation record or login proof.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials

title.zh-TW: 長對話串流與貼圖，不再堵住畫面反應
title.en: Long streaming and pasted images no longer block responsiveness

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕看著長對話持續更新時，畫面現在能維持回應，因為每次更新不再把整段對話重新 normalise（整理成一致格式）。貼上或從剪貼簿讀取 image（圖片）時，也不再阻塞 event loop，負責依序處理畫面與輸入事件的主迴圈，。兩項改動都在避免一件正在進來的內容，堵住其他操作。像書記收到新紙張時，不再每次都把整疊文件重整一次；同事遞來一張照片，也不必讓接待櫃台停擺才能收下。
body.en: Fullscreen streaming stays responsive in long sessions because each update no longer re-normalizes the whole conversation. Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop, the main loop that processes interface and input events. Incoming content no longer has to stop the rest of the interface to be handled.

items.original:
Improved fullscreen streaming: long sessions stay responsive because the whole conversation is no longer re-normalized on every update
Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop

title.zh-TW: 受管理設定的核准視窗，標出來源也分清風險
title.en: Managed-settings approval shows endpoints and separates higher-risk overrides

body.zh-TW: 看到受管理設定的核准對話框時，現在可先看到 endpoint URL（服務連線網址），也會用更清楚的文字說明只改 telemetry，遙測資料，時的意義。一般的 OpenTelemetry 選項不再每次都要求核准，但伺服器管理的 sandbox binary override（替換隔離區使用程式的設定）仍會要求同意，包含 `sandbox.bwrapPath`、`sandbox.socatPath`、`sandbox.ripgrep`。這不是把所有設定放行，而是把例行資料選項和會換掉隔離區工具的設定分開。像簽收單略過普通的聯絡欄更新，卻在有人要更換保險箱鑰匙時，清楚列出地址並請你簽名。
body.en: The managed-settings approval dialog now shows endpoint URLs and explains telemetry-only changes more clearly. Routine OpenTelemetry options are skipped, while server-managed sandbox binary overrides still need approval: `sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, and `sandbox.ripgrep`. It distinguishes routine telemetry settings from changes that replace a sandbox tool.

items.original: Improved the managed settings approval dialog: shows endpoint URLs, uses clearer wording for telemetry-only changes, skips routine OpenTelemetry options, and requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides (`sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`)

title.zh-TW: 回報與程式審查，不必等眼前回覆結束
title.en: Feedback, bug reports, and higher-effort code review no longer hold up the turn

body.zh-TW: Claude 還在回覆時，你現在可立刻開啟 `/feedback` 或 `/bug`，不用等這一輪結束。`/code-review` 選 high、xhigh、max effort（投入較多推理工作的層級）時，也和其他層級一樣改在背景代理執行。前者讓你在想到問題的當下就能開回報入口，後者讓較高工作量的審查不佔住互動對話。像演講還沒結束時，你能先拿到意見卡；需要較久的審稿則交給旁邊的助理處理，講台仍可繼續使用。
body.en: `/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately even while Claude is responding. `/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like other effort levels. One action opens the reporting form without waiting; the other moves the longer review work off the interactive conversation.

items.original:
`/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately when invoked while Claude is responding, instead of waiting for the turn to finish
`/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels

title.zh-TW: 代理完成後更好收納，不再催你建立自訂代理
title.en: Finished agents are tidier and custom-agent nudges are gone

body.zh-TW: 背景代理完成後，agent panel（顯示代理工作的面板）會立刻把它隱藏，底部留下 `/tasks` 提示；「↓ N more」溢出指示也移到左邊，較容易看見。恢復已完成背景代理的訊息改短。啟動時建議建立自訂子代理的提示，以及 `/powerup` 導覽裡相同的催促，也一併移除。這些不改代理怎麼做事，而是整理它完成後留下的資訊與干擾。像待辦牆把完成紙條收進抽屜、把剩餘數量貼到看得見處，也不再每次經過都催你另開一本待辦簿。
body.en: Completed background subagents now hide immediately in the agent panel with a `/tasks` footer hint, and “↓ N more” moved left. The resume message for a completed background agent is shorter. The startup tip about creating custom subagents and the matching `/powerup` nudge are removed. These changes tidy status information rather than change how agents work.

items.original:
Updated agent panel: completed subagents hide immediately with a `/tasks` footer hint, and the "↓ N more" overflow indicator moved left for visibility
Shortened the message shown when resuming a completed background agent
Removed the startup tip suggesting you create custom subagents, and the matching nudge in the `/powerup` tour

title.zh-TW: Cowork 不再把外部記憶匯入直接塞進對話
title.en: Cowork stops inlining external imports from user memory

body.zh-TW: Cowork 工作階段讀取使用者範圍的 memory file（記憶檔）時，外部 `@`-import，用 `@` 引入另一份內容，不再直接 inline，展開後塞入目前內容，。這項改動限定在外部匯入與使用者範圍記憶檔的組合，不是說 Cowork 不再讀取記憶檔本身。它避免一份記憶檔引用的外部內容自動混進目前工作階段。像你借閱一本索引冊時，現在只看到索引指向哪裡，不會把它引用的每本外部書都倒進桌上。
body.en: Cowork sessions no longer inline external `@`-imports from user-scope memory files. This is about external imports being expanded into the current session, not about Cowork ceasing to read the memory file itself. Referenced external content no longer automatically enters the session through that route.

items.original: Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files

title.zh-TW: 沙盒只信指定來源，跨工作階段插槽也拒絕假路徑
title.en: Sandbox paths trust only approved sources and reject planted directories

body.zh-TW: 共用 `/tmp` 裡自動建立的跨工作階段訊息 socket directory（插槽資料夾，讓程式彼此傳訊的位置），若遇到預先放好的 symlink，符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔，或其他使用者的資料夾，現在會拒絕使用。Linux filesystem sandbox（限制程式可碰檔案範圍的隔離區）也補上受保護路徑的繞過防護。`sandbox.ripgrep` 則只接受 user、managed、`--settings` 設定來源，project settings 不再能覆寫沙盒所用的 ripgrep。三項都在收緊檔案與工具的來源邊界。
body.en: The auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory in shared `/tmp` now refuses a planted symlink or another user’s directory. The Linux filesystem sandbox is hardened against a protected-path bypass. `sandbox.ripgrep` is honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings cannot override the sandbox’s ripgrep binary.

items.original:
Hardened the auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory on shared `/tmp`: a pre-planted symlink or another user's directory is now refused instead of used
Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass
Changed `sandbox.ripgrep` to be honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings can no longer override the sandbox's ripgrep binary

entries: Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with a redirect URI mismatch for servers that use a pre-registered OAuth client, such as Slack

title.zh-TW: Slack 的 MCP 登入不再卡在網址不合
title.en: MCP sign-in to Slack no longer stops at a mismatched URL

body.zh-TW: 你想把 Slack 接進 Claude，卻在登入畫面繞了一圈又回到錯誤訊息，問題可能不在你的帳號。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）登入時，伺服器會比對回傳網址。有些服務會使用預先登記好的 OAuth client（用來核對身分的登入設定），原本的網址比對卻對不上。現在這種 redirect URI mismatch（回傳網址不一致）已修好，包含 Slack 這類伺服器。像寄件人與收件人地址其實一致，分揀台以前卻誤判格式不同而退件；現在能把信送回正確入口。
body.en: If you tried to connect Slack to Claude and were sent from sign-in straight back to an error, your account may not have been the problem. During MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that connects AI to external tools) sign-in, the server compares the return URL. Some servers, including Slack, use a pre-registered OAuth client, and that comparison could fail. The redirect URI mismatch is now fixed. It was like a mail sorter rejecting a letter whose address was right but written in a format it did not expect; it can now send the letter to the proper entrance.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with a redirect URI mismatch for servers that use a pre-registered OAuth client, such as Slack

title.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段斷線不再假裝還在忙
title.en: Remote sessions stop pretending they are still working

body.zh-TW: 你離開電腦後用 Remote Control 遠端控制，回來想接著做，現在可用 `claude remote-control --continue` 接回最近一次工作階段。ListAgents 也會把斷線的工作階段標成 `offline`，雲端的標成 `cloud`；筆電終端機輸入斜線指令後，遠端畫面不會再一直轉圈。像車站看板終於分清楚列車是在月台、已離站，還是根本不在線上，不必盯著假進度猜它在做什麼。
body.en: When you return to a Remote Control job, `claude remote-control --continue` resumes your latest session. ListAgents now calls disconnected sessions `offline` and cloud sessions `cloud`; a slash command typed in your laptop terminal no longer leaves the remote client spinning forever. It is like a station board that finally distinguishes a train at the platform, one that has departed, and one that is not on the network at all.

items.original:
Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming the most recent Remote Control session
`ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels your cloud sessions as `cloud`
Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stuck working spinner after a slash command typed in the laptop terminal

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器開工時少踩三種地雷
title.en: Self-hosted runners hit fewer traps at startup

body.zh-TW: 公司自己架的 runner（執行器，替遠端工作接手跑任務的機器）現在比較能順利開工。伺服器可提供 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），行為會跟受管理環境一致；若 `managed-mcp.json` 和伺服器送來的 MCP 伺服器撞在一起，會略過後者並警告，不會一啟動就退出。缺少 Git 憑證時也不再卡在 Credential Manager 問答；Windows 則必須明寫 `--base-dir`。像施工隊先拿到工地地址、碰到重複工單會標記，沒門禁卡就立刻回報。
body.en: A company-run runner can now start with fewer surprises. Server-supplied hooks, small programs triggered by an event, work like those in managed environments. If `managed-mcp.json` conflicts with MCP servers sent by server, Claude warns and skips those servers instead of exiting. Missing Git credentials fail fast, and Windows now requires an explicit `--base-dir`. Like a work crew that receives its site address, flags duplicate work orders, and reports a missing keycard immediately.

items.original:
Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runner sessions, matching managed-environment behavior
Fixed self-hosted runner and other remote sessions exiting at startup when `managed-mcp.json` is deployed and the server delivers MCP servers; those servers are now skipped with a warning
Fixed self-hosted runner repository preparation hanging on a Git Credential Manager prompt; git now fails fast when credentials are missing
Changed self-hosted runner Windows startup to require an explicit `--base-dir`; there is no default checkout directory on Windows

title.zh-TW: 長回覆不中斷，也不會重複說兩遍
title.en: Long replies stay connected and do not print twice

body.zh-TW: Claude 想很久才回話時，Vertex 和 Bedrock 的連線不會被上游當成閒置而切斷了。gateway 串流回應會在思考停頓間送出 SSE keepalive ping（保活訊號，告訴對方連線仍活著的短訊息）；同時，長回覆串流時只顯示一次，也不會有一部分憑空消失。像電話兩端沉默思考時偶爾聽到一聲「我還在」，線路就不會被掛掉，說完的話也不會忽然重播或少半句。
body.en: When Claude pauses to think, Vertex and Bedrock connections are less likely to be cut off as idle. Gateway streams now send SSE keepalive pings, short signals saying connection is alive, during those pauses. Long streamed replies also stop partly disappearing or printing twice. It is like hearing an occasional “I am still here” on a quiet phone call, so line stays open and words do not replay or vanish.

items.original:
Added SSE keepalive pings to gateway streaming responses during long thinking pauses, preventing idle-timeout disconnects on Vertex and Bedrock upstreams
Fixed long responses partly disappearing while streaming and being printed twice in the terminal

title.zh-TW: 外掛來源能跟著本機工具更新
title.en: Plugin sources can follow your local tool

body.zh-TW: 若你的 IDE 要告訴 Claude 外掛放在哪裡，市集現在可把 `command` 設成來源：本機指令印出外掛目錄後，每次工作階段都重新找一次，不必重啟；`mode: "link"` 則直接以那個目錄取代原本內容。單獨跑一次 `claude plugin` 指令後留下的 liveness 檔也會清掉，不再妨礙舊外掛版本清理。像租借櫃的取件地址每次都重新查，搬家後不用重辦會員；用完的號碼牌也不會留在櫃台，堵住後續整理。
body.en: A plugin marketplace can now use `command` as source: local command, such as an IDE, prints plugin directory, which Claude resolves again for each session without restart. With `mode: "link"`, directory replaces installed content. A one-shot `claude plugin` command also cleans up its leftover liveness file, so old versions can be removed. Like checking locker pickup address each visit rather than filing new membership paperwork after move, then returning used ticket to counter.

items.original:
Added plugin marketplace `command` sources: a local command (e.g. an IDE) prints the plugin directory, which is re-resolved each session and applied without a restart; `mode: "link"` uses it in place
Fixed one-shot `claude plugin` commands leaving a stray liveness file that could prevent cleanup of outdated plugin versions

title.zh-TW: 狹窄視窗、怪路徑與壞參數不再把程式撞倒
title.en: Narrow windows, odd paths, and bad arguments stop crashing app

body.zh-TW: 把終端機縮得很窄時，進度列或 Markdown 表格不會再觸發 RangeError，連 `claude --continue`、`--resume` 開機也不會跟著倒下。工具呼叫把本該是文字的 `glob`、`file_path`、`command` 塞成其他型別，程式會避開錯誤畫面；受影響工作階段重新 `--resume` 也一樣。Windows 的 `\\?\` 長路徑與 UNC 網路路徑能處理，原子替換檔案後漏掉的 watcher 控制代號會釋放；排程 watcher 在網路或虛擬檔案系統失敗時不會丟出未接住的錯誤。像窄巷、特殊地址和壞掉的路標都不會讓送貨車翻覆。
body.en: Shrinking terminal no longer lets progress bar or Markdown table trigger RangeError, including when `claude --continue` or `--resume` starts. Tool calls with non-text `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` values avoid crash screen, and Windows accepts `\\?\` extended paths and UNC network paths. File-watcher handles after atomic replacements are released; scheduled watcher failures on network or virtual filesystems are caught. Like delivery truck that can pass narrow lanes, strange addresses, and broken signs without overturning.

items.original:
Fixed a crash to the error screen (including on `--resume` of the affected session) when a tool call had a non-string `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` value
Fixed a RangeError crash when a progress bar or markdown table rendered in a very narrow terminal window (could also crash `claude --continue`/`--resume` at startup)
Fixed a crash on Windows when a tool call or message referenced a file by an extended-length (`\\?\`) or UNC path
Fixed a file-watcher handle leak after atomic file replacements, and an uncaught error on Windows when the scheduled-tasks watcher failed on a network or virtual filesystem

title.zh-TW: 經過閘道連線時，登入與模型選擇更對得上
title.en: Login and model choices line up better through gateways

body.zh-TW: 你若經由自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 閘道連線，claude.ai 訂閱者現在能在 `/model` 選 Sonnet 或 Opus 1M，不會被錯擋；關掉 attribution header（署名標頭，請求附帶來源標示）後，自動模式每次工具呼叫失敗的問題也修了。嚴格的 MCP OAuth 授權伺服器會收到 `127.0.0.1` 而非 `localhost` 的重新導向網址；Claude Desktop 的 OpenTelemetry（遙測，把使用狀況送到觀測端）若也送往 Desktop 管理的閘道，現在可被接受。像同一棟大樓的訪客證、電梯與收件室終於使用同一套地址格式。
body.en: Through custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway, claude.ai subscribers can choose Sonnet or Opus 1M in `/model` again. Disabling attribution header, a source label sent with request, no longer makes every auto-mode tool call fail. Strict MCP OAuth servers now receive `127.0.0.1`, not `localhost`, in redirect URI; Claude Desktop telemetry exports are accepted when Desktop-managed gateway is telemetry endpoint too. Like badges, elevator, and mailroom in one building finally using same address format.

items.original:
Fixed auto mode failing on every tool call for users who disable the attribution header via `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER` (direct Anthropic API connections)
Fixed `/model` rejecting Sonnet/Opus 1M for claude.ai subscribers using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
Fixed MCP OAuth with strict authorization servers by using `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost` in the redirect URI
Fixed OpenTelemetry export from Claude Desktop sessions being rejected by the Desktop-managed gateway when that gateway is also the telemetry endpoint

title.zh-TW: GitHub App 裝好的程式碼審查會真的貼出來
title.en: GitHub App code reviews now get posted

body.zh-TW: 你用 `/install-github-app` 裝好 Claude Code Review，等它跑完卻在 Pull Request（合併程式前請人檢查的提案頁）找不到評論，這個落空已修正。工作流程完成時會把審查貼到該 Pull Request，而不是只在背景宣告自己做完。像你請人改一份文件，對方不再把批註鎖在抽屜裡，會把它貼回你正在看的那一頁。
body.en: After installing Claude Code Review with `/install-github-app`, you may have seen workflow finish but found no comment on Pull Request, page where changes are reviewed before merge. That is fixed: completed workflow posts review on pull request rather than merely finishing in background. Like editor who no longer locks annotations in drawer, but returns them to document page you are reading.

items.original: Fixed the Claude Code Review workflow generated by `/install-github-app` completing without posting its review on the pull request

title.zh-TW: VS Code 裡的側邊工作更好看也更好整理
title.en: VS Code side work is clearer and easier to organize

body.zh-TW: IDE 接著 Claude 時，即使檔案有上千筆診斷訊息，剛編輯完也不會卡住好幾秒。VS Code 裡「Report a problem」和 `/bug` 會開內建回報對話框，不再指向已退休的問卷；`/btw` 追問面板可拖曳調整大小。側欄還能建立、改名、刪除工作階段群組，用 Cmd/Ctrl 或 Shift 點選一次搬多個工作階段。像書桌抽屜能分資料夾，隔板可移動，報修單也終於送到仍有人收件的窗口。
body.en: With IDE connected, editing file with thousands of diagnostics no longer stalls UI for seconds. In VS Code, “Report a problem” and `/bug` open built-in feedback dialog, while `/btw` panel can be resized by dragging. Sidebar now supports session groups: create, rename, delete, then Cmd/Ctrl- or Shift-click to move several sessions. Like desk drawers with labeled folders, movable dividers, and repair forms delivered to a desk that still receives them.

items.original:
Fixed multi-second UI stalls after editing a file with thousands of IDE diagnostics while the IDE extension is connected
[VSCode] "Report a problem" and `/bug` now open the built-in feedback dialog instead of a retired survey link
[VSCode] Made the `/btw` side-question panel resizable by dragging its boundary, in both side-docked and stacked layouts
[VSCode] Added session groups in the sidebar — right-click to create, rename, or delete; Cmd/Ctrl- or Shift-click to move several sessions at once

title.zh-TW: 多人工作流程會避開容器誤判與重複計費
title.en: Multi-agent workflows avoid container mistakes and repeated costs

body.zh-TW: 在 CPU 被限制的 container（容器，把程式隔在一個受限小空間的環境）裡跑動態 workflow，現在會依容器分到的 CPU 數量，而不是誤用主機全部核心數。工作流程分派同一前綴的姊妹 agent（代理，分頭處理任務的執行者）時，也會錯開時間，後來者讀取已快取（cache，把查過結果暫存起來直接用）的提示詞前綴，不重複付費；想關掉可設 `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0`。像廚房按實際爐口排班，後面的人接著看前一張備料單，不必每人重買一箱食材。
body.en: A dynamic workflow inside CPU-limited container now uses CPU limit, not host machine's full core count. When workflow fans out sibling agents with same prefix, it staggers them so later agents read cached prompt prefix instead of paying for it again; set `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` to disable. Like kitchen scheduling cooks by available burners, then letting later cooks read prep sheet rather than buy same ingredients again.

items.original:
Fixed dynamic workflows inside CPU-limited containers using the host machine's core count instead of the container's CPU limit
Improved workflow fan-outs to stagger same-prefix sibling agents so subsequent agents read the cached prompt prefix instead of re-paying it (`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` disables)

title.zh-TW: 空白輸入與裝不下的對話，會給你原因
title.en: Blank input and overfull chats now explain what happened

body.zh-TW: 用 SDK 或 `--input-format stream-json` 送出只含空白的訊息，以前可能收到 400 API 錯誤，現在不再如此。若對話訊息本身已超過 API 的 32 MB 請求上限，且沒有圖片或文件可移除，Claude 不會徒勞重試 compaction（壓縮，把舊對話濃縮以騰出空間），而是一次失敗並說清楚；「提示詞太長」也會解釋為何自動壓縮救不回。像行李箱已塞滿衣物，沒有可拿掉的外套時，櫃檯直接告訴你超重原因，不會反覆硬關拉鍊。
body.en: SDK and `--input-format stream-json` sessions no longer receive 400 API error for whitespace-only message. If messages alone exceed API's 32 MB request limit and no images or documents can be removed, Claude stops retrying compaction, process of condensing old chat to free space, and fails once with clear explanation. “Prompt too long” now explains why automatic compaction cannot recover. Like luggage counter explaining why full suitcase is overweight instead of repeatedly forcing zipper shut.

items.original:
Fixed SDK and `--input-format stream-json` sessions getting a 400 API error when a whitespace-only message was submitted
Fixed conversations whose messages alone exceed the API's 32 MB request limit retrying compaction when no images or documents can be stripped; they now fail once with a clear message
Improved "prompt is too long" errors to explain why automatic compaction could not recover instead of only suggesting `/compact`

title.zh-TW: 安全檢查更嚴，危險操作也不會被默許
title.en: Safety checks tighten, and risky commands lose automatic approval

body.zh-TW: 設定 sandbox（沙箱，把程式關在受限範圍內執行的隔離環境）網路網域時，IPv6 位址會正確加方括號，例如 `[::1]:443`；寫法有歧義會採拒絕連線的安全方向，`/doctor` 也會指出來。`/login` 成功後仍會再次提醒 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` 覆寫警告。更重要的是，`/commit-push-pr` 遇到 `--force`、`--amend`、`--no-verify` 等危險旗標不再自動批准。像門禁遇到看不清的地址先不放行，並提醒你手上舊門卡可能覆蓋新卡，搬動重物前還會要求你親自確認。
body.en: In sandbox, isolated environment where program runs within limits, IPv6 literals in network domain lists are correctly bracketed, such as `[::1]:443`. Ambiguous spellings fail closed and `/doctor` flags them. After successful `/login`, override warning for `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` appears again. Most importantly, `/commit-push-pr` no longer auto-approves dangerous flags like `--force`, `--amend`, or `--no-verify`. Like door staff refusing unclear address, warning that old card may override new one, and requiring you to confirm before moving heavy load.

items.original:
Improved sandbox: IPv6 literals in network domain lists are now bracketed (`[::1]:443`), and ambiguous spellings are enforced fail-closed and flagged by `/doctor`
Updated `/login` to repeat the `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` override warning after a successful login
Changed `/commit-push-pr` so git/gh commands with dangerous flags (`--force`, `--amend`, `--no-verify`, etc.) are no longer auto-approved

title.en: The screen keeps redrawing, and terminal tabs wobble less

body.zh-TW: Claude 還在工作，眼前畫面卻整片不更新，最讓人拿不定主意：該等還是重開？少見的內部版面錯誤曾讓互動工作階段（session，使用 Claude 的一次連續對話）完全停止重畫，但程式仍在跑；現在會避開這個死角。這像直播攝影機卡在同一格，棚內的人仍在繼續說話，觀眾卻看不見後續。另一項小修正針對終端機標題的忙碌旋轉符號；部分終端機的分頁列會因此抖動，現在換了較穩的符號。
body.en: Claude may have kept working while the screen stopped updating, leaving you to wonder whether to wait or restart. A rare internal layout error could halt redraws in an interactive session even though its process was still running; that failure is now avoided. It was like a live camera frozen on one frame while the people in the studio kept talking. A smaller change replaces busy-spinner glyphs in the terminal title, reducing tab-bar jitter in some terminals.

items.original:

Updated terminal title busy-spinner glyphs to reduce tab-bar jitter on some terminals

title.zh-TW: Windows 從上層資料夾啟動，也找得到 Git
title.en: Windows can find Git even when Claude starts above its folder

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 用 Claude Code 管理專案時，明明裝了 Git，卻被說找不到它，接下來的版本控制工作就全斷了。問題出在 Claude Code 從 Git 安裝資料夾的上層資料夾啟動時，`git` 或 Git Bash 可能找不到。這次修正的是尋路方式，不是替你安裝另一套 Git。像你知道工具放在某棟大樓，卻因為從大樓外的路口出發而沒找到入口；現在從那個上層路口出發，也能順著路走到 Git。
body.en: On Windows, Claude Code could say Git was missing even when it was installed, cutting off version-control work. The failure happened when Claude Code was launched from a parent folder of Git's installation: `git` or Git Bash might not be found. This changes how it finds the existing installation; it does not install another Git. It was like knowing a tool is in a building but missing the entrance because you started at a nearby intersection. Now that route reaches Git too.

items.original: Fixed `git` / Git Bash not being found on Windows when Claude Code is launched from a parent folder of the git installation

title.zh-TW: 模型選擇不倒退，檔案寫入規則也講清楚
title.en: Model choice no longer rolls back, and Write rules are clearer

body.zh-TW: 你用 `/model` 換過模型，再打 `/tui` 回文字介面，不該被偷偷送回上一個模型；現在選擇會保住。檔案操作也調整了：較新的模型使用 Write 工具時，即使這次工作階段還沒讀過既有檔案，也可覆寫它，規則已和 Edit 工具一致；舊模型仍得先讀再寫。這像你在車站換好月台，轉頭看時刻表卻被帶回舊月台，現在不再發生。Pro、Max、Team 第一次使用提示裡「自動模式會稍微更貴」的過時說明也移除了，別再把舊提醒當現況。
body.en: After changing models with `/model`, opening `/tui` should not quietly return your session to the earlier model; it now keeps your choice. An outdated first-use note claiming auto-mode sessions cost slightly more has also been removed for Pro, Max, and Team plans.

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳話看得見，遠端續聊不洩題
title.en: Cross-session messages are visible, without leaking resumed chats

body.zh-TW: 兩個工作階段（session，使用 Claude 的一次連續對話）互傳訊息時，第一個工作階段在安裝或升級後偶爾沒有收件匣，訊息也縮成一行；現在收件匣會建立，寄件者和內容直接顯示。傳到另一台機器的 Remote Control 工作階段，寄件者則會顯示你的遠端控制工作階段名稱。另一面更重要：連著 Remote Control 打 `/resume` 時，剛恢復的對話標題或歷史不會再漏進目前連線的工作階段。像辦公室便條終於有收件盤、署名和全文，但隔壁會議室的舊紀錄仍鎖在門內。
body.en: When two sessions exchange messages, the first session after an install or upgrade could sometimes have no inbox, and messages were collapsed to one line. Now an inbox is created and both sender and body appear inline. For messages sent to a Remote Control session on another machine, the sender shows your Remote Control session name. More importantly, using `/resume` while connected through Remote Control no longer leaks a resumed conversation's title or history into the connected session. It is like office notes gaining an inbox, signature, and full text while old records in the next meeting room stay behind a locked door.

items.original:

title.zh-TW: 自架 runner 不再無端失敗或提早收工
title.en: Self-hosted runners stop failing for irrelevant repos or ending early

body.zh-TW: 自己架 `claude self-hosted-runner` 跑工作時，一個根本不會推送的 repository，其 checkout 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）失敗，竟能讓每個全新 runner 的工作階段都失敗。現在這種 repository 會跳過並給警告，不再拖垮整次工作。背景任務完成到後續回合開始之間，runner 以前也可能誤把工作階段結束；這段交棒空隙已補上。像接力隊遇到不參賽的器材櫃壞了，過去全隊被迫退賽，現在繞過它並留下告示，接棒的人也不會還沒拿到棒就被判離場。
body.en: When running `claude self-hosted-runner` yourself, a checkout hook failing for a repository the session would never push to could make every fresh runner session fail. Such a repository is now skipped with a warning instead of taking down the work. A runner could also end a session in the handoff gap after a background task finished but before its follow-up turn began; that gap is now covered. It is like a relay team being disqualified because a broken equipment locker was never part of the race. Now they pass it with a notice, and the next runner is not dismissed before receiving the baton.

items.original:
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` sessions failing on every fresh runner when the `checkout` hook fails for a repository the session doesn't push to; that repository is now skipped with a warning
Fixed self-hosted runners ending sessions in the gap between a background task finishing and the follow-up turn starting

title.zh-TW: 清理時保住專案記憶與開發中的外掛
title.en: Cleanup keeps project memory and in-development plugins intact

body.zh-TW: 專案裡有 memory 資料夾，或你正用符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）開發外掛時，最怕背景清理把該保留的東西當垃圾。先前工作階段清理可能刪掉專案 memory 資料夾裡的內容；背景的外掛快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）清理，也可能在唯一版本是符號連結開發副本時刪掉該外掛快取。兩種誤刪都修正了。像管理員整理辦公室時，把貼在專案櫃裡的筆記和工作室裡正在使用的開發工具一起丟掉；現在不會再把這兩類東西清走。
body.en: If you keep a project's memory folder so Claude retains context, or develop a plugin through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing somewhere else), cleanup must not mistake active material for trash. Session cleanup could delete contents inside the project's memory folder. Background plugin-cache cleanup could also delete a plugin's cache when its only version was a symlinked development checkout. Both accidental deletions are fixed. It was like an office manager clearing out notes in a project cabinet and active tools inside the workshop; now those live materials are recognized.

items.original:
Fixed session cleanup deleting contents inside a project's memory folder
Fixed background plugin-cache cleanup deleting a plugin's cache when its only version is a symlinked development checkout

title.zh-TW: 市集設定各自算帳，不再串到別層標頭
title.en: Marketplace settings no longer inherit headers from another tier

body.zh-TW: 同一個 marketplace 項目在不同優先層的設定裡各有一份時，較高層重新定義它，本來應該整份換掉；舊行為卻可能把較低層的自訂 headers 一起帶過來。現在 marketplace 項目會以完整項目合併，不再東拼西湊。這對管理多組設定的人很重要：你改的是高優先層那張表單，就不會暗中繼承另一張表單的標頭。像公司把同名供應商的新版合約放到最上層，過去卻把舊合約頁首頁尾黏上去；現在會採用新版合約的完整內容。
body.en: When the same marketplace entry existed in settings tiers with different precedence, redefining it in a higher tier should have replaced the whole entry. Instead, custom headers from another tier could be inherited. Marketplace entries now merge as whole entries, rather than as a mix of pieces. This matters if you manage several layers of settings: changing the higher-precedence form will no longer quietly bring along headers from another form. It was like filing a supplier's new contract on top, then accidentally gluing the old contract's letterhead onto it. Now the full new contract is used.

items.original: Fixed a settings-merge issue where a marketplace entry redefined in a higher-precedence settings tier could inherit another tier's custom headers; marketplace entries now merge as whole entries

title.zh-TW: 技能提示不重複，本機指令也不會被雲端蓋掉
title.en: Skill reminders stop duplicating, and cloud skills cannot override local controls

body.zh-TW: 叫用一個 skill（技能，教 Claude 怎麼處理特定工作的說明）後，deferred tools 提醒有時會送給模型兩次，現在只送一次。更關鍵的是，從 claude.ai 同步下來的技能收緊了：它不能遮蔽你本機指令或 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示，描述會先清理並標示來源；在你的機器上，技能本文也不會執行 `!` 指令或展開 `@` 檔案。像外來的操作手冊可以放上書架參考，卻不能把你桌上的按鈕貼住，更不能自行翻出抽屜裡的文件。
body.en: After invoking a skill (instructions that tell Claude how to handle a particular kind of work), the deferred-tools reminder could sometimes be sent to the model twice; it now appears once. More importantly, skills synced from claude.ai are restricted: they cannot shadow local commands or MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompts, their descriptions are sanitized and labeled, and their bodies cannot run `!` commands or expand `@` files on your machine. An outside manual may sit on your shelf, but it cannot cover the buttons on your desk or open files from your drawers by itself.

items.original:
Fixed the deferred-tools reminder occasionally being sent to the model twice after a skill invocation
Hardened skills synced from claude.ai: they no longer shadow local commands or MCP prompts, their descriptions are sanitized and labeled, and on your machine their bodies don't run `!` commands or expand `@` files

title.zh-TW: 憑證失效早點說，整理對話也看得到進度
title.en: Expired credentials fail fast, and compaction shows its progress

body.zh-TW: Vertex AI 的 Google Cloud 憑證（credential，證明你可登入服務的資料）過期或缺漏時，過去會重試好幾分鐘才失敗，現在幾秒內就會回報。你不用盯著像壞掉的電梯按鈕一直亮著，卻不知道它到底有沒有在動。Claude 整理過長對話的 compaction（壓縮，把前面內容濃縮以騰出對話空間）也補了更實在的訊號：重試倒數與卡住提示會在進行中出現，不再只剩一條進度列。前者讓錯誤快點浮面，後者讓等待中的人知道它是在重試還是真的停住。
body.en: When Google Cloud credentials for Vertex AI are expired or missing, Claude Code used to retry for minutes before failing; it now fails within seconds. You no longer have to stare at a lit elevator button without knowing whether anything is moving. Compaction, which condenses an overlong conversation to make room, also shows more useful signals: its retry countdown and a stall hint now appear while it runs instead of leaving only a progress bar. One change surfaces an error sooner; the other tells a waiting person whether it is retrying or has stopped.

items.original:
Improved Vertex AI credential handling: expired or missing Google Cloud credentials now fail within seconds instead of retrying for minutes
Improved compaction progress: the retry countdown and stall hint now appear during compaction instead of only a progress bar

Fixed every Bash command failing under `claude-code-action` with `allowed_non_write_users` on GitHub-hosted runners
Fixed `/tui` bringing back a conversation that had been rewound to before its first message
Improved slash-command menu: blue now marks only the selected row, matched characters are bolded instead of recolored, and emoji or accented names keep their glyphs

title.zh-TW: 登入過期時，Max 使用者不再被誤催開啟用量額度
title.en: Expired logins no longer nudge Max users toward usage credits

body.zh-TW: 你明明訂了 Max 方案，剛開啟工作階段卻被催著替 Fable 開啟用量額度，感覺像進電影院時會員資料一時讀不到，售票員便誤以為你不是會員，要求你改辦一般票。問題出在登入 token（證明你已登入的數位令牌）過期時：功能旗標（feature flags，用來分批開啟功能的開關）檢查漏看了你的訂閱層級。現在即使一開始遇到過期 token，這項檢查也會帶上方案資訊，不會再錯誤提示 Max 用戶替 Fable 啟用 usage credits。
body.en: You may be on a Max plan yet get nudged to enable usage credits for Fable when a session opens. That was like a cinema clerk unable to read a member record and mistakenly asking a member to buy a regular ticket. If your login token had expired, feature flags were checked without your subscription tier. Those checks now include it, so Max users are no longer wrongly prompted to enable usage credits for Fable.

items.original: Fixed feature flags being evaluated without the user's subscription tier when a session started with an expired login token, which could wrongly prompt Max plan users to enable usage credits for Fable

title.zh-TW: GitHub 雲端執行器不再拒跑所有 Bash 指令
title.en: GitHub-hosted runners can execute Bash again

body.zh-TW: 你把專案交給 GitHub 自動跑檢查，卻發現 Bash（在終端機執行指令的常用工具）每一條都失敗，像工地門口明明有施工名單，警衛卻把整班工人全攔下來。這次問題出現在 GitHub-hosted runner（GitHub 提供、替你執行自動化工作的雲端電腦）搭配 `claude-code-action`，而且設定了 `allowed_non_write_users` 時；這個設定是允許沒有寫入權限者執行的名單。現在這組設定下的 Bash 指令能正常執行，原本的允許名單不再反而讓工作完全停擺。
body.en: If GitHub is running checks for your project and every Bash command fails, the automation has become a worksite where the guard blocks every worker despite a valid list. This affected `claude-code-action` on GitHub-hosted runners when `allowed_non_write_users` was set—the list that permits users without write access. Bash commands now run normally with that setup, so the permission list no longer stops all work.

items.original: Fixed every Bash command failing under `claude-code-action` with `allowed_non_write_users` on GitHub-hosted runners

title.zh-TW: 倒帶到對話起點後，/tui 不再把舊對話叫回來
title.en: /tui no longer resurrects a conversation rewound to its start

body.zh-TW: 想把對話徹底倒回第一句以前、從空白重來時，最怕明明擦掉的內容又冒回畫面。先前若你把對話 rewind（倒回先前狀態）到第一則訊息之前，再輸入 `/tui` 開啟文字介面，舊對話可能被帶回來，像擦乾淨白板後按了開關，昨天的字又浮現。現在 `/tui` 會尊重你倒帶的位置：已倒到起點前的對話維持在那裡，不再被介面重新叫回。這是修正既有行為，不是新增一種刪除方式。
body.en: When you rewind a conversation to before its first message to start from a blank slate, erased words should stay erased. Previously, opening the text interface with `/tui` could bring that conversation back, like yesterday's writing reappearing after you wiped a whiteboard and flipped a switch. `/tui` now respects the rewind point: a conversation rewound before its start stays there instead of being revived by the interface. This fixes existing behavior; it does not add a new way to delete chats.

items.original: Fixed `/tui` bringing back a conversation that had been rewound to before its first message

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令選單更好認：只標選中項、保留表情符號
title.en: Slash-command menu makes the selection—and every name—clearer

body.zh-TW: 指令很多時，你靠選單找 `/` 指令，畫面不該把每個相關項目都染成同一種藍色。現在藍色只標出目前選到的那一列；搜尋命中的字元改用粗體，讓你仍能看出名稱本來的顏色。名稱含 emoji（表情符號）或重音字母時，字形也會完整保留，不再被選單弄得面目全非。它像車站的電子看板：亮的是你眼前要搭的那班車，符合搜尋的字則加粗，外國站名與圖示仍照原樣顯示。這是 slash-command menu（輸入 `/` 後出現的指令清單）的閱讀調整，不改變指令本身。
body.en: When a command list is long, a slash-command menu should not paint every matching item the same blue. Blue now marks only the row you selected, while matched characters are bold so each command name keeps its own color. Names containing emoji or accented characters also keep their glyphs intact. Think of a station board: your train is lit, matching letters are bold, and foreign station names and icons remain legible. This improves how the menu reads; it does not change the commands themselves.

items.original: Improved slash-command menu: blue now marks only the selected row, matched characters are bolded instead of recolored, and emoji or accented names keep their glyphs

title.zh-TW: 找不到檔案或檢查 @ 提及時，畫面少卡一下
title.en: Fewer pauses while checking missing-file suggestions and @-mentions

body.zh-TW: 輸入檔案名稱卻找不到、或在對話裡加上 `@` 提及內容時，介面原本可能在背後檢查的空檔頓一下。這次減少了 event loop（程式用來輪流處理畫面與工作事件的節奏）在兩種檢查上的停滯：找不到檔案時產生建議，以及檢查 @ 提及內容的大小。像接線生本來要先停下來翻兩本簿子，才繼續接下一通電話；現在較少卡在那一步，畫面和其他工作有更多機會繼續往前。更新說的是效能改善，並沒有改變找不到檔案時的建議內容或 @ 提及的大小檢查規則。
body.en: When a file name cannot be found or you add an @-mention in a conversation, the interface could pause while checking in the background. This release cuts event-loop stalls in two places: generating missing-file suggestions and checking the size of an @-mention. It is like a switchboard operator who no longer has to stop as often to search two ledgers before taking the next call. The screen and other work get more chances to keep moving. This is a performance improvement, not a change to suggestion contents or @-mention size rules.

items.original: Improved performance: fewer event-loop stalls on file-not-found suggestions and at-mention size checks

title.zh-TW: 額度用完時，原因與恢復時間說清楚
title.en: Usage-limit warnings now explain the cap and reset time

body.zh-TW: 公司替 Claude Code 設了使用上限，做到一半跳出「額度已滿」時，最煩的是不知道誰設的、何時能再做。現在透過 gateway（閘道，替公司統一管控連線的中介服務）使用時，警告會直接列出上限金額、重設時間，以及管理者留下的訊息。像停車場出口的看板，從前只亮紅燈；現在會寫清楚今日上限、幾點重新開放，還附上管理室交代。這項支援需要 gateway 升到 2.1.225。
body.en: If your company sets a Claude Code spending limit, hitting it halfway through work used to leave you guessing who set it and when work could resume. When you connect through a gateway, the warning now names the cap, reset time, and operator message. It is like a parking-lot exit sign that once showed only red; now it says today's limit, when entry reopens, and what management wants you to know. The gateway must be on 2.1.225.

items.original: Added gateway spend-limit support to Claude Code's usage warning; the limit-reached message now names the cap, its reset time, and the operator's message (requires the gateway on 2.1.225)

title.zh-TW: 進陌生資料夾前，agents 也會先問你
title.en: Agents now ask before working in an untrusted folder

body.zh-TW: 你把下載來的專案交給 `claude agents` 處理前，現在會先看到工作區信任提示。工作區信任（workspace trust，確認這個資料夾可放心讓工具在裡面工作的確認）原本已在 `claude` 指令裡出現，這次讓 agents 的行為跟上。它像進陌生人家裡修東西：先問主人能不能進門，再開始翻工具箱；確認過的資料夾才繼續。遇到網路抓下來、還沒看過內容的專案時，這道提醒尤其有用。
body.en: Before handing a downloaded project to `claude agents`, you now get a workspace-trust prompt. Workspace trust is a confirmation that a folder is safe for tools to work in. Claude already asked this question; agents now behave the same way. It is like repairing something in a stranger's home: ask before entering, then open the toolbox. This matters most for projects fetched from the internet that you have not inspected yet.

items.original: Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`

title.zh-TW: 登入短暫失靈，不再把長期憑證換掉
title.en: Brief 401 errors no longer replace durable login credentials

body.zh-TW: 沒有畫面的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行方式）工作跑到一半，碰上一個暫時的 401 錯誤，以前可能被換成短命登入 token（授權令牌，用來證明登入身分的通行碼），得重啟才救得回來。macOS 的 MCP OAuth 伺服器也會在鑰匙圈讀取逾時後，突然連發 401，像從沒登入過。現在兩種狀況都修正了。這像交通卡讀卡器一時失靈，卻把你的月票剪成單次票；它現在不會亂換卡。
body.en: A headless job can run without a terminal window. During one, a temporary 401 error used to replace a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a short-lived login token, breaking the job until restart. On macOS, MCP OAuth servers could also emit a burst of 401s after a Keychain read timed out. Both cases are fixed. It was like a transit-card reader briefly failing and then cutting your monthly pass into a one-trip ticket; it no longer swaps the card.

items.original:
Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart
Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors, as if never authenticated, after a keychain read timed out

title.zh-TW: 自動模式被拒後，會換路而非原地重試
title.en: Auto mode moves on after a blocked action instead of retrying

body.zh-TW: 自動模式（auto mode，Claude 自己執行操作、逐步少問一次的模式）要請權限卻被安全篩選器拒絕時，操作仍會被擋下；這次拒絕不計入連續受阻次數，模型會收到往下做的提示，改往其他可繼續做的步驟前進，不再重試。像自助結帳機刷不過某張折價券，店員仍不讓它通過，但也不會讓機器一直重刷同一張；它會改成繼續處理購物籃裡的其他東西。
body.en: When auto mode asks for permission and a safety filter refuses that check, the action still stays blocked. The refusal no longer counts toward the consecutive-block limit, and the model is told to move on rather than retry. Think of a self-checkout that cannot accept one coupon: staff still reject it, but do not make the machine scan the same coupon forever; it continues with the rest of the basket.

items.original: Fixed auto mode counting a safety-filter refusal of its own permission check toward the consecutive-block limit; the action is still denied, but the model is now told to move on rather than retry

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息不再無聲停在半路
title.en: Cross-session messages no longer disappear into a silent queue

body.zh-TW: 你在沒有畫面的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行方式）環境，或 Claude Code 剛啟動時傳跨工作階段訊息，過去訊息可能停在佇列裡，既不提醒也不會過期。現在這個問題修好了，不必再像盯著一直沒叫號的號碼牌那樣等著。跨工作階段訊息是不同 Claude 工作階段之間的傳話；它該送達、該告知時就會有明確結果，而非悄悄停住。
body.en: Send a message between Claude sessions from a headless environment, or during startup, and it could previously sit in a queue with neither notice nor expiry. That is fixed. A cross-session message is a handoff between separate Claude sessions; it should now produce an outcome rather than resemble a letter wedged silently inside a mailbox. You no longer need to wonder whether it is waiting forever.

items.original: Fixed cross-session messages staying parked without a notice or expiry in headless sessions and during startup

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制重連後，不再把舊進度越堆越多
title.en: Remote Control reconnects stop piling up old progress

body.zh-TW: 用 Remote Control（遠端控制，從另一台裝置查看或接手 Claude 工作）接續超長對話時，先前壓縮過的聊天記錄可能讓恢復失敗；網頁工作階段還會被誤判卡住，每次重連又重送更多舊事件。現在這兩處都修正。它像接續播放清單：以前播放器既找不到停下的位置，又把已播曲目一首首重放；現在能從原處接回，也不會讓舊內容越疊越厚。
body.en: With Remote Control, you can inspect or take over Claude work from another device. Resuming a huge conversation after its history was compacted could fail, while web sessions could be falsely called stuck and resend an ever-growing backlog on each reconnect. Both are fixed. It was like rejoining an online meeting where the host lost the first half of the notes and replayed every old slide; now the meeting resumes where it stopped without piling up history.

items.original:
Fixed conversation history breaking on Remote Control session resume after very large conversations were compacted
Fixed Claude Code on the web sessions being misreported as stuck, re-sending a growing event backlog on every reconnect

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制收到的照片，直接交給 Claude 看
title.en: Remote Control now hands app photos directly to Claude

body.zh-TW: 你在 Claude app 附上一張照片給 Remote Control（遠端控制，從另一台裝置查看或接手 Claude 工作）的工作階段時，Claude 現在直接收到照片，不必再用另一個工具從磁碟讀檔。要它看截圖、收據或白板照片時，這條路少了一次繞行。像把相片交到對方面前，而不是先放進倉庫，再請對方拿鑰匙去找；照片仍是同一張，只是交接方式改得更直接。
body.en: Attach a photo in the Claude app to a Remote Control session and Claude now receives it directly, rather than fetching it from disk with a separate tool call. When you ask it to inspect a screenshot, receipt, or whiteboard photo, the handoff has one less detour. It is like handing someone a picture instead of storing it in a warehouse and asking them to fetch it with a key: same photo, more direct delivery.

items.original: Improved Remote Control: photos attached from the Claude app are now shown to Claude directly instead of being read from disk with a separate tool call

title.zh-TW: agents 不會因滑過別的專案就走錯資料夾
title.en: Agents keep the right folder, and runners fail early on bad paths

body.zh-TW: agents 清單裡把滑鼠移到另一個專案的工作階段上，下一個 agent 以前可能改在那個專案的資料夾啟動，現在不會了。另一邊，`claude self-hosted-runner` 的 `--base-dir` 若無法建立或寫入，過去會先註冊、每個工作階段才失敗；現在啟動時就明白報錯並退出。像派車中心不再因瞄到隔壁訂單就把司機派錯地址，車庫門打不開也會在出車前說清楚，不會每趟才拋錨。
body.en: Hovering over a session from another project in the agents list could previously change the folder where the next agent started. It no longer does. Separately, if `claude self-hosted-runner` cannot create or write its `--base-dir`, it now exits with a clear startup error instead of registering and failing every session. It is like dispatch no longer sending a driver to a neighbor's address after glancing at their order, and reporting a locked garage before every trip breaks down.

items.original:
Fixed hovering over a session in another project in the agents list changing the directory the next agent starts in
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` registering and then failing every session when `--base-dir` cannot be created or written; it now exits at startup with a clear error

title.zh-TW: VS Code Focus 視圖不再把待辦與答案藏掉
title.en: VS Code Focus keeps current work and answers visible

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 的 Focus view（專注檢視，把對話內容折疊整理的畫面）裡追 Claude 的進度時，最新待辦、未回答問題的脈絡，甚至已解決的答案，之前可能被折起來看不見。現在它們會留在眼前；只有純思考內容會折疊，並標成「Thought for Ns」，等該輪結束再收回。像整理收納盒：行動清單和結論放在最上層，草稿筆記才暫時收到盒底。
body.en: When following Claude in VS Code's Focus view, the newest to-do list, context for a pending question, and settled answers could be folded away. They now stay visible. Only thinking-only sections fold, show “Thought for Ns,” and collapse again once that turn finishes. Think of folded meeting notes: the action list and conclusion remain on top, while rough scratch work goes inside the pages.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view folding away the latest to-do list, a pending question's context, and settled answers; thinking-only folds show "Thought for Ns" and re-collapse when their turn completes

title.zh-TW: 可直接傳話給其他機器上的遠端工作階段
title.en: SendMessage can reach named Remote Control sessions on other machines

body.zh-TW: 想請另一台機器上的 Remote Control 工作階段幫忙，現在 `SendMessage` 可依名稱直接開啟對話，不必等對方先傳話。`ListAgents` 會把它顯示成 `name [ref]`，方便辨認遠端對象。你確認過的遠端收件人，也不會因本機剛好有同名工作階段、而且清單查不到遠端時，被偷偷換成那一個。像依取件編號交付物品：先用名稱和編號認出指定對象；即使遇到同名者，已確認的對象也不會被換掉。
body.en: Want help from a Remote Control session on another machine? `SendMessage` can now start a conversation with it by name; you no longer have to wait for it to write first. `ListAgents` shows it as `name [ref]`. A Remote Control recipient you already confirmed also cannot be silently replaced by a same-named local session if its remote list cannot be checked. It is registered mail: find the addressed recipient first, and do not hand the confirmed letter to a namesake.

title.zh-TW: 把自己的電腦接成 Claude 的工作站
title.en: Turn your own machines into Claude workstations

body.zh-TW: 公司有內網程式、特殊硬體或私有資料，卻想從網頁、手機或桌面版繼續叫 Claude 幫忙嗎？Team 與 Enterprise 方案現在可執行 `claude self-hosted-runner`，把你自己的電腦或容器變成可執行工作階段的地方。像把家裡的一台工作桌登記進共享辦公室：人仍可從不同入口進來，真正動手的地方則留在你準備好的機器上。
body.en: Need Claude to work where your internal software, special hardware, or private data already live? Team and Enterprise users can run `claude self-hosted-runner` to make their own machine or container a place where Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions run. Think of registering your workbench in a shared office: you can enter through different doors, while the actual work stays on the machine you prepared.
