title.zh-TW: 外掛可直接從 ZIP 檔安裝
title.en: Install plugins straight from ZIP files

body.zh-TW: 拿到公司提供的外掛 ZIP 檔，現在不必先架 Git 或 npm。新的 `archive` plugin source 可透過 HTTPS 從 ZIP 安裝 plugin（外掛，替 Claude 加上功能的小元件），還能附上 SHA-256 指紋來核對下載檔。這像到售票亭取票：HTTPS 是領票窗口，SHA-256 指紋像票券防偽碼，對得上才確認票沒有被調包。
body.en: When your company gives you a plugin ZIP, you no longer need Git or npm first. The new `archive` plugin source installs a plugin from a ZIP over HTTPS and can pin its SHA-256 digest to check the downloaded file. It is like collecting a ticket at the box office: HTTPS is the collection window, and the SHA-256 digest is the ticket's security code that confirms it was not swapped.

items.original: Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning

title.zh-TW: 貼回舊內容前先讓你看一眼
title.en: A safer second look before restoring pasted text

body.zh-TW: 命令列裡貼過一段文字又想復原，最怕原本的命令被悄悄換掉。現在移除不可用的 paste（貼上內容）會改變命令文字時，先提供取消與確認；叫回或還原的舊貼上內容，也不會因內容過期或預留編號撞號而接錯資料、漏字。被接受回輸入框的預留編號會重新編號，所以同一段內容不會因舊號碼混在一起造成誤接了。像編輯文件前先跳出變更預覽，按下確認才落筆。
body.en: When you restore pasted text in a command, you do not want the command itself quietly changed. If removing an unavailable paste would change that text, Claude Code now asks you to cancel or confirm. Recalled or restored paste content also avoids wrong attachments or lost text when it has aged out or placeholder numbers collide; accepted placeholders are renumbered. Like reviewing tracked changes before they are applied.

items.original:
Added a cancel-and-confirm step when removing an unavailable paste changes a command's text
Fixed recalled or restored paste content occasionally attaching wrong data or silently losing text when the paste had aged out or placeholder numbers collided
Changed recalled paste placeholder numbers to renumber when accepted into the input

title.zh-TW: Bedrock 可優先指定跨區推論設定
title.en: Prefer a chosen cross-region Bedrock profile

body.zh-TW: 同一個 AWS 帳號有多個區域可用時，Bedrock 不必只跟著 `AWS_REGION` 猜該用哪個跨區推論設定。新增環境變數（environment variable，程式啟動時讀取的設定值）`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX`，可讓 Bedrock 優先選指定的 cross-region inference profile。這像導航本來只看你所在城市，現在可先告訴它要走哪條跨城主幹道。
body.en: If your AWS account can use several regions, Bedrock no longer has to infer the cross-region inference profile solely from `AWS_REGION`. Set the new environment variable `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` to prefer a particular profile. It is like a navigation app that once looked only at your current city and can now be told which intercity route to prefer.

items.original: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile over the `AWS_REGION`-derived one

title.zh-TW: 不同工作階段可以互傳訊息，但危險收件先等你點頭
title.en: Sessions can message each other, with a safety hold

body.zh-TW: 你在桌機跑一個任務、筆電跑另一個時，現在可用 `ListAgents` 找到其他工作階段，再以 cross-session `SendMessage` 互傳訊息，macOS 與 Linux 都可用。若收件工作階段正以略過權限確認的方式執行，`crossSessionInbound` 與 `dialogExpiry` 設定會先把訊息扣住等你核准；其他工作階段則自動送達。送入隊友收件匣真的失敗時，也會如實報錯，不再假稱已送出。像辦公室郵件分流：普通收件桌直接投遞，略過確認的工作站則先送進你的待核准匣。
body.en: With one task on your desktop and another on your laptop, sessions can now find each other through `ListAgents` and exchange cross-session `SendMessage` messages on macOS and Linux. Messages sent into a session running with bypassed permissions can be held for your approval through `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry`; other sessions receive them automatically. A failed delivery now reports an error instead of pretending it succeeded. It is like office mail sorting: ordinary desks receive mail directly, while a workstation running with checks bypassed sends it to your approval tray first.

Removed the 200-subagent-per-session spawn cap; long-running sessions no longer refuse new agents (concurrency and depth limits still apply)

title.zh-TW: 沙盒遮住憑證，也把違規原因講清楚
title.en: The sandbox masks credentials and explains denials

body.zh-TW: 要讓 Claude 在 sandbox（沙盒，隔離程式可碰範圍的保護區）裡處理含登入資料的環境變數時，新增的遮罩選項可從結構化值擷取資料、在找不到時處理，或解讀 JWT 後遮住指定欄位；AWS 簽名也可用 `awsPairs`、`sigv4` 重新簽署。它們需要 `network.tlsTerminate`，且只信任使用者、受管理或 `--settings` 設定。另一方面，`denyRead: "~/.aws/"` 這類尾端斜線不再可繞過；Bash 被拒絕存取時，Claude 會看見哪個檔案或網路請求被擋與原因。像寄出資料前遮住帳號的文件副本；若傳送被拒，退件單會列出哪個檔案或網路請求及原因。
body.en: When Claude handles environment values containing credentials inside the sandbox, new masking options can extract structured values, handle no-match cases, or decode JWTs and hide chosen claims; `awsPairs` and `sigv4` can re-sign AWS requests. They require `network.tlsTerminate` and only honor user, managed, or `--settings` settings. A trailing slash in `denyRead: "~/.aws/"` can no longer bypass a filesystem denial, and Bash results now tell Claude which file or network access was denied and why. It is like redacting account numbers from a document copy before sending it; a rejection slip then names the file or network request and the reason.

Fixed sandbox filesystem deny entries written with a trailing slash (e.g. `denyRead: "~/.aws/"`) being silently bypassable on Linux and macOS
Fixed sandbox violation details never appearing in Bash tool results; Claude now sees which file or network access was denied and why

title.zh-TW: 超長專案路徑不會串到別人的工作階段
title.en: Very long project paths stay in their own sessions

body.zh-TW: 專案資料夾路徑超過 200 個字元時，過去可能因共用的簡化前綴，被解析到另一個專案的 session（工作階段，一次持續進行的對話與工作紀錄）目錄。現在已隔開：列清單、重新命名、fork、刪除與 `/resume` 都不會跨到別的專案。這特別影響名稱很長、層級很深的專案。像圖書館把太長的書名縮成書背標籤，開頭相同的兩本書就可能被放到同一格；如今有能分清它們的編號。
body.en: A project path longer than 200 characters could once resolve to another project's session directory because both shared a sanitized prefix. Session listing, renaming, forking, deletion, and `/resume` now remain within the right project. It is like a library shortening long book titles on their spine labels: two books with the same opening could land in one slot, but now their identifiers distinguish them.

items.original: Fixed long (>200 char) project paths resolving to another project's session directory under a shared sanitized prefix; session list, rename, fork, delete and `/resume` no longer cross projects

title.zh-TW: 中途接上的 MCP 工具不再隱形，外掛紀錄也不會寫壞
title.en: Mid-turn MCP tools are visible, and plugin records stay intact

body.zh-TW: 對話進行中才接上的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具，以前會被延後到工具搜尋，模型卻不知道它叫什麼；現在會先宣告名稱。另一邊，同一個 plugin（外掛，替 Claude 加上功能的小元件）裝進多個專案時，安裝紀錄不再悄悄損壞。像新同事半途進會議，現在會先報上名字，名冊也不會因他出現在兩個專案而撕破。
body.en: An MCP tool that connects mid-turn used to be deferred to tool search without its name being announced to the model; now its name is announced. Separately, installing the same plugin in more than one project no longer silently corrupts its installation record. Like a colleague joining a meeting halfway: they introduce themselves, and the attendance book does not tear because they work on two projects.

items.original:
Fixed MCP tools that connect mid-turn being deferred for tool search without their names announced to the model
Fixed plugin install records being silently corrupted when the same plugin is installed in multiple projects

title.zh-TW: Wayland 選取即複製較不會漏到剪貼簿
title.en: Wayland copy-on-select reaches the clipboard reliably

body.zh-TW: 在 Wayland 上反白文字後，偶爾會發現複製內容根本沒進剪貼簿，只好再選一次或手動複製。原因是兩次選取寫入互相搶時間，像兩個人同時在同一塊白板寫字，後寫的可能蓋掉先寫的。這次讓兩次寫入不再競跑，因此 copy-on-select（選取即複製）能更可靠地送到 clipboard（剪貼簿，暫放複製內容的地方），選到的內容比較不會半路突然消失。
body.en: On Wayland, selected text could sometimes fail to reach the clipboard because two selection writes raced each other. It was like two people writing on the same whiteboard at once, where the later writing can cover the earlier one. Those writes no longer race, so copy-on-select reaches the clipboard more reliably.

items.original: Fixed copy-on-select on Wayland sometimes not reaching the clipboard; the two selection writes no longer race

title.zh-TW: 回饋逐字稿分享失敗會講明，也會說明多傳了什麼
title.en: Transcript sharing reports failure and explains extra context

body.zh-TW: 長對話結束後分享回饋逐字稿，過去失敗了仍可能顯示成功；現在失敗會顯示錯誤。你同意分享時，內容也會包含最後一次請求的模型設定：包含 `CLAUDE.md` 指示的 system prompt、工具定義與模型參數。祕密資料仍會遮掉；檔案太大時，這些新增欄位會最先被捨棄。像點餐螢幕：清楚顯示訂單有沒有送出，也列出你同意加上的附加項目。
body.en: After a long session, a failed feedback-transcript share used to look successful; it now shows an error. With your consent, a share also includes the last request's model settings: the system prompt including `CLAUDE.md` instructions, tool definitions, and model parameters. Secrets remain redacted, and these fields are dropped first if the share is too large. Like an ordering screen that shows whether the order went through and lists the extras you agreed to add.

items.original:
Fixed the feedback survey's transcript share silently failing on long sessions; a failed share now shows an error instead of a success message
Changed the feedback-survey transcript share: with your consent it now also uploads the last request's model settings — the system prompt (which includes your `CLAUDE.md` instructions), tool definitions, and model parameters. Secrets are redacted as before, and these fields are dropped first if the share is too large

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 斷線、重連與清空畫面都更誠實
title.en: Remote Control is clearer about failures, resets, and reconnects

body.zh-TW: 用 Remote Control（遠端控制，從網頁或手機接上 Claude Code 工作階段）時，冷啟動碰上過期登入 token（授權令牌，驗證身分用的短記號）不再偶發自動啟動失敗。連線失敗會持續顯示原因與重新連線捷徑，不只閃八秒提示；VS Code 也不會在失敗後假裝已連上。`/clear` 等沒有輸出的命令不再留下一則空白訊息，清空會同步到已連線的網頁與手機；壓縮進度與壓縮後的分界也會顯示。伺服器工作階段過期後重建時，舊的本機對話不會上傳進新工作階段，過期的伺服器紀錄會封存；你手動關掉 Remote Control 後恢復工作階段也不會私自重連，明確開啟 `remoteControlAtStartup` 時則會被 VS Code 遵守。像遠端會議室的門牌、白板和舊錄影都各自對上，不會把上一場的人帶進來。

Recreated server sessions do not upload prior local history, stale server sessions are archived, resuming does not secretly reconnect after you turned it off, and VS Code honors an explicit `remoteControlAtStartup`. Like a remote meeting room whose sign, whiteboard, and old recording all point to the right meeting.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲回去仍看得到完整壓縮前歷史
title.en: Fullscreen keeps the whole pre-compaction history

body.zh-TW: 長對話反覆 compaction（壓縮，把早期對話濃縮以騰出空間）後，以前全螢幕捲動區只保留最近一段壓縮前內容。現在 scrollback（可向上捲看的終端機歷史）會保住完整的壓縮前歷史，即使已經連續壓縮多次，也能一路往回看。你回頭找最早的指令、討論或決定時，不用只看到最後一次壓縮前的零碎片段。像錄音檔的時間軸保留每一段，即使整理過多次也能倒回最早的錄音。
body.en: After repeated compaction, which condenses earlier conversation to make room, fullscreen scrollback once kept only the most recent pre-compaction interval. Fullscreen now retains the full pre-compaction history across repeated compactions, so you can scroll all the way back. It is like an audio-recording timeline that preserves every segment: even after being organized many times, you can rewind to the earliest recording.

items.original: Improved fullscreen mode to keep the full pre-compaction history in scrollback across repeated compactions, instead of only the most recent interval

title.zh-TW: 組織設定沒變，換帳號後不再重問同意
title.en: Unchanged managed settings stop asking again

body.zh-TW: 在公司帳號重新登入或切換組織後，若 managed settings（受管理設定，由組織統一指定的設定）完全沒變，Claude Code 不會再重複跳出核准提示。只有組織的設定內容完全不變才適用；規則更新時仍是另一回事。這不是放寬新設定，而是記得你已看過同一份規則。像文件只換了封面、內容完全沒有變，也不必重新簽同一份同意書。
body.en: After signing in again or switching organizations, Claude Code will not ask for approval again when the managed settings are unchanged. It is not relaxing a new setting; it remembers that you already reviewed the same rules. Like a document with a new cover but unchanged contents: there is no need to sign the same consent form again.

items.original: Changed managed settings: the approval prompt no longer re-appears after re-login or org switching when the organization's settings are unchanged

title.zh-TW: Claude 會知道指令輸出不一定看得到
title.en: Claude is told that command output may not reach you

body.zh-TW: 你叫 Claude 執行指令後，畫面上未必會可靠地顯示每一行輸出；但模型本身能讀到。Bash tool（Bash 工具，讓 Claude 執行終端機指令的工具）說明現在固定寫明這件事，避免它把「我看到了」誤當成「你也看到了」。這是工具說明的調整，提醒模型不要以為螢幕上的呈現一定同步。像劇院後台的提詞稿：主持人看得到完整內容，觀眾席的字幕卻可能沒跟上。
body.en: After Claude runs a command, its output is displayed to the model but may not reliably be displayed to you. The Bash tool description now always states that distinction, so Claude does not confuse “I saw it” with “you saw it too.” Like a theater's backstage prompt script: the presenter sees the full content, but subtitles for the audience may not have caught up.

items.original: Changed the Bash tool description to always note that command output is displayed to the model, not reliably to the user

title.zh-TW: GitHub 組織的外掛市集可整批放行或封鎖
title.en: Allow or block an entire GitHub organization's marketplaces

body.zh-TW: 公司管理者不必再替 GitHub 組織底下每個外掛市集逐一開名單。現在受管設定能用 `"owner/*"` 這種萬用字元，`owner` 換成組織名稱，星號代表它底下所有市集。想只准公司核可的來源，可在 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 加入它；若整個組織都不能用，則放進 `blockedMarketplaces`。例如 ` {"strictKnownMarketplaces":["acme/*"]} ` 會承認 acme 組織所有市集。這像大樓門禁直接認一整棟公司的識別證，不必替每位員工各登一筆。
body.en: An administrator no longer has to list every marketplace under a GitHub organization one by one. Managed settings now accept an owner wildcard such as `"owner/*"`: replace `owner` with an organization name, and the asterisk covers all of its marketplace repositories. Put it in `strictKnownMarketplaces` to allow that organization, or `blockedMarketplaces` to bar it. For example, ` {"strictKnownMarketplaces":["acme/*"]} ` recognizes every Acme marketplace. It is like a building pass that admits an entire company's badge series instead of registering every employee separately.

title.zh-TW: 子代理模型受限時，會說明誰接手工作
title.en: A warning explains when parent model takes over for a restricted subagent

body.zh-TW: 你安排工作流程 agent（代理，能分頭處理工作的 AI 助手）、分叉的技能、斜線指令，或恢復背景代理時，可能替子代理指定某個模型；但組織政策若不准用它，原本很容易以為事情根本沒跑。現在 Claude 會跳出警告：子代理想要的模型受限，改由父代理模型執行。它沒有憑空換成別的任務，只是換了可用的腦袋。像劇團原定的演員臨時不能上台，舞台經理會明說由誰代演，觀眾不必對著陌生面孔猜半天。
body.en: When a workflow agent, forked skill, slash command, or resumed background agent requests a particular subagent model, an organization policy may forbid it. Previously that could look as though nothing had happened. Claude now warns that the requested model is restricted and that the parent model is running instead. The agent has not quietly become a different task; it is using an available brain. It is like a theater manager announcing a substitute actor when the scheduled performer cannot go on, rather than leaving the audience to guess why someone else appeared.

items.original: Added a warning when workflow agents, forked skills, slash commands, or resumed background agents' requested subagent model is restricted and the parent model runs instead

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作做到一半，可帶回本機接著做
title.en: Continue a cloud session on your own machine

body.zh-TW: 在雲端 session（工作階段，一次連續的對話與工作紀錄）裡做到一半，想回自己電腦處理檔案時，畫面現在會提示 `/teleport`。照提示輸入 `claude --teleport <session id>`，就能在本機繼續那個工作階段；`<session id>` 要換成畫面給你的識別碼。這不是複製一份新對話，而是把同一段工作從雲端接到眼前。像把做到一半的拼圖從客廳桌搬到書房桌，仍接著拼同一幅圖。
body.en: If you are halfway through a cloud session and need to return to your computer to work with local files, Claude now shows a `/teleport` hint. Run `claude --teleport <session id>` locally, replacing `<session id>` with the identifier shown in the cloud session, and continue that session on your machine. This is not a copied new chat; it carries the same work from the cloud to your computer. Like moving a half-finished puzzle from the coffee table to a desk and continuing the same picture.

items.original: Added a `/teleport` hint in cloud sessions showing how to continue locally with `claude --teleport <session id>`

title.zh-TW: 權限檢查不再被藏起來的指令騙過
title.en: Permission checks can no longer be fooled by hidden commands

body.zh-TW: 按下核准前，權限對話框現在會更可靠地露出命令全貌。有人若在 Bash 指令裡做手腳，用 tab 或看不見的 Unicode 字元遮住一段內容，檢查不再會漏看；工作流程 script 也不能靠動態 `import()` 從 workflow sandbox（工作流程沙盒，限制程式活動範圍的隔離區）外執行程式。另一個缺口也補上了：代理定義裡略過權限的 `bypassPermissions` 模式不得違反組織政策。這像工廠品管驗貨，不只看箱面標籤，還會拆開包材查隱藏內容；流水線只能在劃定工作區操作，公司訂下免檢禁令後，也不能被某張作業單推翻。
body.en: Before you approve a command, the permission dialog can now show its full shape more reliably. A crafted Bash command cannot hide pieces from checking, and tabs or invisible Unicode characters cannot conceal part of a command from the approval dialog. Workflow scripts also cannot use dynamic `import()` to run code outside the workflow sandbox, and an agent definition's `bypassPermissions` mode must obey an organization policy that disables permission bypasses. Think of factory quality control: inspectors open the packaging rather than checking only its label, work stays within its marked area, and no work order can override a company ban on skipping inspection.

Fixed workflow scripts being able to use dynamic `import()` to run code outside the workflow sandbox

title.zh-TW: 中斷後回來的工作階段，較不會卡死或空白
title.en: Resumed sessions are less likely to come back blank or stuck

body.zh-TW: 你在對話中用過 `/cd` 換資料夾，之後再恢復 session（工作階段，一次連續的對話與工作紀錄），不會莫名回到空白位置。分叉的背景 agent 若在恢復時重建父提示詞失敗，也不會整場對話都被鎖成「already resuming」；歷史裡壞掉的 diagnostics attachment（診斷附件，記錄除錯資訊的附檔）則不再害每一回合失敗或讓互動程式停在沒反應的錯誤畫面。這像接力賽交棒時有三個容易掉棒的關卡：換跑道、找回前一棒的說明、檢查破損的紀錄；現在其中一關出錯，不會讓整隊永遠停在原地。
body.en: If you used `/cd` to change folders during a conversation, resuming that session will no longer come back empty. A forked background agent whose parent prompt cannot be rebuilt during resume also will not remain stuck as “already resuming” for the rest of the session. And a malformed diagnostics attachment in the history will no longer make every turn fail or leave the interactive app frozen on an error screen. These are three handoff points in a relay race: changing lanes, recovering the previous runner's instructions, and checking a damaged record. One bad handoff no longer stops the team forever.

items.original:
Fixed resuming a session after a mid-session `/cd` coming back empty
Fixed forked background agents getting stuck "already resuming" for the rest of the session when rebuilding the fork's parent prompt failed during resume
Fixed a resumed session failing every turn, or leaving the interactive app on an unresponsive error screen, when its history held a malformed diagnostics attachment

title.zh-TW: 不同來源標記的 Claude 模型，不再認錯名字
title.en: Claude models with provider-prefixed names are recognized correctly

body.zh-TW: 透過 gateway（閘道，替不同 AI 服務轉接請求的入口）找模型時，名稱前面帶供應商標記的 Claude 以前可能直接消失。例如 `vertex_ai/claude-*` 與 `bedrock/anthropic.claude-*` 現在都能被發現。同時，`modelOverrides` 裡不是 Anthropic 模型 ID 的鍵，不會再被誤當成這個 session 的正式模型 ID；文件說未知鍵應忽略，現在照做。像同名乘客在車票前多印了旅行社名稱：查票員會認出人，卻不會把旅行社名稱誤寫進護照欄位。
body.en: When a gateway discovers models, Claude names with a provider prefix no longer disappear. IDs such as `vertex_ai/claude-*` and `bedrock/anthropic.claude-*` are now found. Also, a key in `modelOverrides` that is not an Anthropic model ID will no longer be mistaken for the session's canonical model ID; unknown keys are ignored as the documentation says. It is like a ticket inspector recognizing a passenger whose ticket starts with a travel-agency label, without copying the agency name into the passenger's passport field.

items.original:
Fixed gateway model discovery hiding Claude models registered under provider-prefixed IDs such as `vertex_ai/claude-*` or `bedrock/anthropic.claude-*`
Fixed `modelOverrides` keys that aren't Anthropic model IDs being treated as the session's canonical model ID; unknown keys are now ignored as documented

title.zh-TW: 管理端與本機的環境變數，現在會合併保留
title.en: Admin and local environment settings now merge instead of replacing each other

body.zh-TW: 公司從伺服器發下 managed settings（受管設定，由管理者統一控制的設定）時，本機 `managed-settings.json` 或 MDM 裝置管理設定檔裡的 `env` 區塊以前可能整個失效。現在管理端的環境變數會按鍵名合併，本機設定不會因為收到另一份設定就被整段蓋掉。兩份名單都寫了不同開關時會並列保留。像總公司寄來新的值班表，不再把分店牆上原有、沒有衝突的聯絡電話全數撕掉。
body.en: When a company delivers managed settings from its server, the `env` block in a machine-local `managed-settings.json` or an MDM profile used to risk being disabled altogether. It now merges administrator environment variables by key, so receiving another settings source does not replace the whole local block. Different switches from both lists remain present; the rules still decide what happens when the same key appears. It is like headquarters sending a new duty roster without tearing down every non-conflicting phone number already posted in a branch office.

items.original: Fixed managed settings: server-delivered settings no longer disable the env block of a machine-local `managed-settings.json` or MDM profile; admin env now merges per key

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙盒與罕見 Git 輸出，不再讓指令卡住
title.en: Linux sandboxes and unusual Git output no longer stall commands

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 把工作資料夾列入 `sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite`（沙盒禁止寫入的路徑清單）後，沙盒指令以前可能連啟動都失敗，現在能正常啟動。另一個少見但惱人的停滯也修掉了：解析某些不尋常的 `git push` 輸出時，不再偶爾掛住。像倉庫的輸送線：標示禁止封箱的貨仍可上線運送；遇到格式罕見的出貨單，站員也能繼續處理，不會讓整條線停住。禁止寫入照舊，指令與 Git 則能把工作做完。
body.en: On Linux, putting the working directory under `sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite` used to make a sandboxed command fail before it could start. It can now launch normally. Another rare but irritating stall is fixed too: parsing unusual `git push` output no longer occasionally hangs. Think of a warehouse conveyor: a parcel marked “do not seal” can still go onto the line, and staff can process an unusually formatted shipping slip without stopping it. Writes remain forbidden, while the command and Git can finish their work.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when `sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite` covers the working directory
Fixed a rare hang when parsing unusual `git push` output

title.zh-TW: 長對話的自動壓縮，會更嚴守模型容量
title.en: Auto-compaction now respects model context limits more consistently

body.zh-TW: 工作階段越堆越長時，會啟用自動壓縮（auto-compaction，把前段內容濃縮以騰出空間）。它現在會更早守住模型的 context window（上下文視窗，模型一次能記住的內容容量）。`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` 已改成：所有原生支援 1M 視窗的 Claude 模型都會透過壓縮維持在 200K，並在沒守住時於啟動時警告。遇到不認得的模型 ID，也會假定一個容量並在超限前壓縮，不再任它長過頭。若你要恢復後一項的舊行為，請在啟動 Claude 的環境變數加入 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1`。像行李箱裝滿前先整理衣物，而不是等拉鍊裂開才發現放不下。
body.en: As a conversation grows, auto-compaction now more consistently protects a model's context window: the amount of conversation it can hold at once. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` now keeps every Claude model with a native 1M window at 200K through compaction, and startup warns if that limit is not being held. For an unrecognized model ID, Claude now assumes a window and compacts before it is exceeded rather than allowing unchecked growth. To restore the old behavior for unrecognized IDs, add `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1` to the environment that launches Claude. It is like folding clothes before a suitcase is full, not waiting for the zipper to split.

items.original:
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` to hold every Claude model with a native 1M window to 200K via auto-compaction, not just a fixed list; a startup warning now appears when auto-compaction isn't holding the session to 200K
Changed auto-compact to keep sessions on unrecognized model IDs within the assumed context window instead of letting them grow past it; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1` to restore the previous behavior

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查指令統一，也會記住你上次要多仔細
title.en: Code review commands are unified and remember your chosen depth

body.zh-TW: 準備送出改動或 PR（pull request，請人檢查並合併程式改動的請求）前，`/review` 現在就是 `/code-review` 的另一個名字。輸入 `/code-review` 可檢查目前 diff（差異，尚未合併的程式改動）或 PR；要指定深度可用 `/code-review <level> <pr#>`，例如 `/code-review ultra` 要求深入的雲端審查。第二次審查若不填 level，會沿用你上次選的程度；想改成 high，就輸入 `/code-review high`。像同一個洗衣店有兩個入口招牌，現在都通往同一張櫃台，店員還記得你上回選的是快洗還是精洗。
body.en: Before submitting changes or a PR, `/review` is now another name for `/code-review`. Run `/code-review` to review the current diff or a PR; use `/code-review <level> <pr#>` to choose a depth, and `/code-review ultra` for a deep cloud review. If you omit the level next time, it reuses the level you last chose. To switch to high, type `/code-review high`. It is like two signs for one laundry counter: both lead to the same service, and the clerk remembers whether you chose a quick wash or careful cleaning last time.

Changed `/code-review` with no effort level to reuse the level you typed last; type a level like `/code-review high` to change it

title.zh-TW: 代理各做各的，安全界線不再被繞過
title.en: Agents stay in their lanes, with safety checks intact

body.zh-TW: 你讓 Claude 在工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）裡處理另一件事時，最怕它回頭動到主工作副本。現在不論哪種工作階段，隔離都同時管住檔案編輯和 Bash 指令，子代理也不能對主工作副本下破壞性 Git 指令。背景任務裡的 PreToolUse 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）原本能自動放行而繞過工具限制，這個缺口也補上了。代理要用 SendMessage 傳話給另一個工作階段，訊息會先交給權限分類器檢查；若某個 skill 標了 `disable-model-invocation`，Claude 會請你親自執行，不會照著猜流程重做一遍。像把分工的人各留在自己的房間，門禁和鑰匙都還在。
body.en: When Claude is handling another task in a worktree, you do not want it reaching back into your main checkout. Isolation now covers both file edits and Bash commands in every session type, so those sessions and their subagents cannot run destructive Git commands against the main checkout. A PreToolUse hook that could auto-allow its way around tool limits in background tasks has also been fixed. Messages sent with SendMessage to another agent session now pass through the permission classifier first. And when a skill is marked `disable-model-invocation`, Claude tells you to run it yourself instead of imitating its workflow. It is like keeping each collaborator in their own room while leaving the locks in place.

items.original:
Fixed worktree-isolated sessions and their subagents being able to run destructive git commands against the main checkout; isolation now applies to file edits and Bash in every session type
Fixed PreToolUse auto-allow hooks bypassing tool restrictions in background agent tasks (summaries, compaction, renames)
Improved auto mode safety: messages sent to other agent sessions via `SendMessage` are now evaluated by the permission classifier before dispatch
Improved the refusal when Claude tries to invoke a skill with `disable-model-invocation`: Claude is now told to ask you to run the skill instead of replicating its workflow

title.zh-TW: 被駁回過的額度申請，現在能重新送出
title.en: Dismissed credit requests can be sent again

body.zh-TW: 你在 Team 或 Enterprise 方案替成員申請 `/usage-credits`，先前那次若被駁回，本來該能再送一次。舊版卻把被駁回的申請誤當成還在處理，跳出「你已送出用量點數申請」並把人擋在門外。現在這扇門會在申請被駁回後重新打開：成員可以提出新的用量點數申請，不必因為上一張失敗的申請一直卡住。這就像申請通道在上一份申請被駁回後重新開放，讓你再送一份新申請。
body.en: On a Team or Enterprise plan, a member whose earlier `/usage-credits` request was dismissed should be able to submit another one. Instead, Claude Code treated that dismissed request as if it were still pending, showed “you've already sent a usage credit request,” and blocked the new request. That record now stops blocking the member after dismissal. It is like an application channel reopening after a dismissal, so you can send a new request.

items.original: Fixed `/usage-credits` on Team and Enterprise showing "you've already sent a usage credit request" for members whose earlier request was dismissed, blocking them from sending a new one

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器後的連線，不再假斷線或卡到失敗
title.en: Connections behind proxies stop timing out by mistake

body.zh-TW: 公司網路走 HTTPS proxy（替你轉送加密網路連線的中介站）時，Claude Code 啟動前的連線檢查曾會卡住，最後才失敗。它現在改用和 API 請求相同、認得 proxy 的連線方式，逾時也會說清楚原因。回覆其實已經完整送達，卻被標成「回覆中途關閉」的誤報也修好了。若你把 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 指到自訂 gateway，伺服器明明持續送 keep-alive ping，閒置逾時器以前仍會響；現在會把這些 ping 算進去。像快遞車隔著轉運站仍持續回報位置，收件人不會再被通知包裹半路遺失。
body.en: If your company network uses an HTTPS proxy, Claude Code's startup check used to hang and then fail. It now uses the same proxy-aware transport as API requests and gives a clear timeout message. The false “Connection closed mid-response” report is also gone when a response had already finished. And when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points to a custom gateway, the idle timer now recognizes keep-alive pings arriving from the server instead of timing out anyway. Think of a parcel still reporting its location through a transfer station: the recipient should not be told it vanished halfway there.

items.original:
Fixed the startup connectivity check hanging and then failing behind an HTTPS proxy; it now uses the same proxy-aware transport as API requests and times out with a clear message
Fixed "Connection closed mid-response" errors being reported on responses that had actually completed
Fixed stream idle timeout firing on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways despite server keep-alive pings arriving on the wire

title.zh-TW: 用量、登入與錯誤訊息，終於各自說對話
title.en: Usage, sign-in, and errors now tell the right story

body.zh-TW: 你查 `/usage` 時，MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的用量不會再被算得太多：只有實際消耗到它回傳工具結果的請求，才會歸到它名下。claude.ai connector 的工作階段 token（登入驗證用的令牌）失效時，畫面不會假稱還要授權，而會提示你用 `/login` 登入。若你剛移除一台 MCP 伺服器，原本看不到的工具錯誤也會顯示出來；SendMessage 遇到太長的摘要則會截短後送出，不會撞上字數上限直接失敗。把它想成客服中心的案件流程：只有案件確實採用了某櫃台提供的資料，該櫃台才計入用量；通行證失效就附上 `/login` 指示；撤掉櫃台後，舊案件的錯誤紀錄仍可查看；交接摘要太長，先裁到收件欄上限再送出。
body.en: When you open `/usage`, an MCP server is no longer charged for every turn after someone called it. Its share now includes only requests that actually consumed its tool results. If a claude.ai connector has an invalid session token, it shows a `/login` hint rather than wrongly asking for authorization. Tool errors also remain visible after the local MCP server that supplied a tool has been removed. Finally, SendMessage truncates an overly long summary instead of failing on its character limit. Think of a customer-service desk's ticket workflow: only a ticket that actually used a desk's supplied information counts usage for that desk; an invalid pass gets a `/login` instruction; an old ticket's error record stays viewable after its desk closes; and an overlong handoff summary is trimmed to fit the receiving field before it is sent.

items.original:
Fixed `/usage` overattributing usage to MCP servers: a server's share now reflects only the requests that actually consumed its tool results, instead of every turn after any call to it
Fixed claude.ai connectors being falsely marked as needing authorization when the session token is invalid — they now show a `/login` hint instead
Fixed tool errors not being displayed for tools no longer available locally, for example after an MCP server is removed
Fixed `SendMessage` rejecting a long summary — it now truncates instead, so sends no longer fail on a character limit

title.zh-TW: 分支、差異與遠端遙控，回到你真正的設定
title.en: Branches, diffs, and Remote Control follow the right settings

body.zh-TW: 你先推送分支、之後才建立 pull request 時，Claude Code 現在也能把工作階段連到那張 PR，包括透過 GitHub REST API 建立的 PR。查看 `/diff`、Remote Control 工作區差異或網頁版編輯差異時，它會直接讀 Git blob 的原始內容，不再受專案自訂 diff driver 或 textconv 影響；同一份變更不會被不同顯示規則扭曲。Remote Control 則收緊了啟動權：專案裡的 `.claude/settings.json` 與 `.claude/settings.local.json` 只能把它關掉，不能偷偷開啟；要開請在使用者範圍輸入 `/config`。像共用專案能貼告示說「今天不營業」，卻不能替每位同事擅自開門。
body.en: If you push a branch and create its pull request later, Claude Code can now link the session to that PR, including one created through the GitHub REST API. The `/diff` view, Remote Control workspace diff, and web-session file-edit diffs now read raw Git blob content, so project-configured diff drivers and textconv no longer distort what is shown. Remote Control also has a tighter start switch: repo-local `.claude/settings.json` and `.claude/settings.local.json` may turn it off, but cannot turn it on. To enable it, use `/config` at user scope. A shared project can post a “closed today” sign, but it cannot quietly open every collaborator's door.

items.original:
Fixed sessions not linking to pull requests created after the branch was pushed, including through the GitHub REST API
Improved the `/diff` view, the Remote Control workspace diff, and file-edit diffs in Claude Code on the web sessions to use raw git blob content, ignoring workspace-configured diff drivers and textconv
Changed Remote Control auto-start so repo-local settings (`.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json`) can no longer turn it on (they can still turn it off); enable it at user scope via `/config`

title.zh-TW: 代理選模與進度顯示更準，UltraPlan 功能下架
title.en: Agent model choices and progress labels are corrected; UltraPlan is removed

body.zh-TW: 組織限制某個模型家族時，子代理或隊友指定 `model: opus` 這類別名，先前可能錯退回父代理的模型。現在它會在同一家族裡往下改選組織允許的最新模型，選擇和限制終於對得上。子代理逐字稿的 spinner（畫面上轉圈的等待動畫）標籤改了。它會顯示子代理自己的 `effort:`（思考力道／投入程度的設定），不再顯示整個工作階段的等級。若主機用 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` 管理模型，主機的選模鍵會壓過磁碟裡過期的 `managed-settings.json`。另外，UltraPlan 功能已移除。像派工板終於標出每個人的實際班別，總部的最新規則也不再被檔案櫃裡的舊紙條蓋過。
body.en: When an organization restricts a model family, a subagent or teammate using an alias such as `model: opus` could previously fall back to the parent agent's model. It now steps down within that family to the newest model the organization allows. A subagent transcript's spinner effort label now shows that subagent's own `effort:` setting, not the session-wide level. When the host manages models through `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`, its model-selection keys now beat stale on-disk `managed-settings.json` values. UltraPlan has also been removed. It is like a staffing board finally showing each person's actual shift, while the current rule from headquarters no longer loses to an old note in a filing cabinet.

items.original:
Fixed org-restricted `model: opus`-style subagent and teammate family aliases dropping to the parent model instead of stepping down to the newest org-allowed model in the family
Fixed the spinner's effort label in a subagent's transcript view showing the session's effort level instead of the subagent's own `effort:` setting
Fixed host model-selection keys not taking precedence over a stale on-disk `managed-settings.json` when `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` is set
Removed ultraplan feature

title.zh-TW: 檔案監看更穩，螢幕閱讀器不再重念整行
title.en: File watching is steadier, and screen readers stop repeating lines

body.zh-TW: 你正在輸入問題又按了退格鍵，使用 `--ax-screen-reader` 模式的螢幕閱讀器以前會把整行輸入內容重新念一遍；現在刪除行尾文字時只回應剛刪掉的字元，耳朵不用反覆聽同一句。另一個少見但惱人的中斷也補好了：檔案監看器碰到檔案系統錯誤，或正在結束監看時，Claude Code 可能會當掉。現在這兩種時刻不再引發罕見崩潰。像校對員擦掉句尾一個字，只念那個被擦掉的字；門口的值班員遇到小狀況，也不會整間辦公室關燈離開。
body.en: While you are typing and hit Backspace, a screen reader in `--ax-screen-reader` mode used to read the entire input line again. Deleting at the end of a line now echoes only the characters just deleted, so you do not have to hear the same sentence repeatedly. Another rare interruption is fixed too: Claude Code could crash when its file watcher met a filesystem error or while that watcher was shutting down. Those moments no longer cause the rare crash. It is like a proofreader who erases one character at the end and reads only that character aloud, while the person watching the door does not switch off the whole office over a small incident.

items.original:
Fixed rare crashes when a file watcher hit a filesystem error or during file-watcher teardown
Fixed screen readers re-reading the whole input line on every backspace in `--ax-screen-reader` mode — end-of-line deletions now echo just the deleted characters
